title.zh: 卷九十一 志第六十七 兵三
title.raw: 卷九十一 志第六十七 兵三 Volume 91 Treatises 67: Military 3

sentences.zh: 邊防 海防江防 民壯 士兵 鄉兵

translations.literal: Border Defense; Sea Defense and River Defense; Civilian Strongmen; Garrison Soldiers; Village Troops
translations.idiomatic: Border Defense; Sea and River Defense; Civilian Militia; Garrison Troops; Local Militia

sentences.zh: 元人北歸，屢謀興復。

translations.literal: After the Yuan people returned north, they repeatedly plotted restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Yuan had withdrawn to the north, they repeatedly schemed to restore their rule.

sentences.zh: 永樂遷都北平，三面近塞，正統以後，敵患日多。

translations.literal: Yongle moved the capital to Beiping; on three sides it lay near the frontier passes; after the Zhengtong reign, enemy threats grew daily.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongle Emperor relocated the capital to Beiping, the dynasty was exposed on three sides to the northern marches; after the Zhengtong era, border alarms became ever more frequent.

sentences.zh: 故終明之世，邊防甚重。

translations.literal: Therefore throughout the entire Ming dynasty, border defense was heavily weighted.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason border defense remained a paramount concern throughout the Ming.

sentences.zh: 東起鴨綠，西抵嘉峪，綿亙萬里，分地守禦。

translations.literal: From the Yalu in the east to Jiayu Pass in the west, a continuous line of ten thousand li was parcelled out for territorial defence.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yalu River in the east to Jiayu Pass in the west, defences stretched unbroken for thousands of li, with each sector assigned its own garrison.

sentences.zh: 初設遼東、宣府、大同、延綏四鎮，繼設寧夏、甘肅、薊州三鎮，而太原總兵治偏頭，三邊制府駐固原，亦稱二鎮，是為九邊。

translations.literal: Initially four military commissions were set up—Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, and Yansui; then three more—Ningxia, Gansu, and Jizhou; while the Taiyuan regional commander governed Piankou and the Three Borders commandery was stationed at Guyuan—counting these two as additional commissions, making the Nine Border Garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: At first four frontier commands were established—Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, and Yansui—followed by Ningxia, Gansu, and Jizhou; with the Taiyuan commander at Piankou and the Three Borders headquarters at Guyuan counted as two more, comprising the famed Nine Garrisons along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武六年，命大將軍徐達等備山西、北平邊，諭令各上方略。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the sixth year of Hongwu, the emperor ordered Grand General Xu Da and others to prepare the Shanxi and Beiping frontiers, instructing each to submit strategic plans.
translations.idiomatic: As early as Hongwu year 6, the Hongwu Emperor ordered Grand General Xu Da and others to ready the Shanxi and Beiping borders and directed each officer to present a defensive plan.

sentences.zh: 從淮安侯華雲龍言，自永平、薊州、密雲迤西二千餘里，關隘百二十有九，皆置戍守。

translations.literal: Following the advice of Huai'an Marquis Hua Yunlong, from Yongping, Jizhou, and Miyun westward for more than two thousand li, one hundred twenty-nine passes and barriers were all garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the recommendation of Huai'an Marquis Hua Yunlong, garrisons were posted at all 129 passes and barriers along more than 2,000 li from Yongping and Jizhou through Miyun westward.

sentences.zh: 於紫荊關及蘆花嶺設千戶所守禦。

translations.literal: At Zijing Pass and Luhua Ridge thousand-household offices were established for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-household commands were set up to guard Zijing Pass and Luhua Ridge.

sentences.zh: 又詔山西都衛於雁門關、太和嶺並武、朔諸山谷間，凡七十三隘，俱設戍兵。

translations.literal: The court also ordered the Shanxi regional command to place garrison troops at all seventy-three strategic points among Yanmen Pass, Taihe Ridge, and the valleys of Wu and Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: The throne further directed the Shanxi Regional Military Commission to station troops at seventy-three defiles from Yanmen Pass and Taihe Ridge through the Wu and Shuo uplands.

sentences.zh: 九年，敕燕山前、後等十一衛，分兵守古北口、居庸關、喜峯口、鬆亭關烽堠百九十六處，參用南北軍士。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, it ordered the eleven guards of Yanshan Front and Rear and the like to divide troops to guard the 196 beacon towers at Gubeikou, Juyong Pass, Xifeng Pass, and Songting Pass, using northern and southern troops together.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, eleven guards including those of the Yanshan front and rear districts were ordered to divide forces among 196 beacon posts at Gubeikou, Juyong Pass, Xifengkou, and Songting Pass, drawing on troops from both north and south.

sentences.zh: 十五年，又於北平都司所轄關隘二百，以各衛卒守戍。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, troops from the guards under Beiping Regional Command were again assigned to garrison two hundred passes in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15, soldiers from each guard under the Beiping Regional Command took turns manning 200 frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 詔諸王近塞者，每歲秋勒兵巡邊。

translations.literal: Princes near the frontier were ordered each autumn to drill troops and patrol the border.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes whose domains lay near the marches were commanded every autumn to muster their forces and ride the border circuit.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命徐達籍上北平將校士卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Xu Da was ordered to register officers and soldiers in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17, Xu Da was commissioned to compile a register of officers and men in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 復使將核遼東、定遼等九衛官軍。

translations.literal: He was again sent to verify the officers and troops of the nine guards including Liaodong and Dingliao.
translations.idiomatic: He was again dispatched to audit the officer and troop rolls of nine guards, including Liaodong and Dingliao.

sentences.zh: 是後，每遣諸公、侯校沿邊士馬，以籍上。

translations.literal: After this, dukes and marquises were repeatedly sent to survey border personnel and horses along the frontier and report them upward.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter grand dukes and marquises were repeatedly sent to inspect troops and horses along the frontier and submit registers to court.

sentences.zh: 二十年，置北平行都司於大寧。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the Northern Pacification Regional Command was established at Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, the Beiping Pacification Regional Command was founded at Daning.

sentences.zh: 其地在喜峯口外，故遼西郡，遼之中京大定府也；

translations.literal: Its territory lay beyond Xifeng Pass; it was the ancient Liaoxi commandery, the Zhongjing Dading Prefecture of Liao;
translations.idiomatic: The post lay beyond Xifengkou in the old Liaoxi prefecture—the Liao dynasty's Central Capital at Dading;

sentences.zh: 西大同，東遼陽，南北平。

translations.literal: west of Datong, east of Liaoyang, south of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: west of Datong, east of Liaoyang, and south of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 馮勝之破納哈出，還師，城之，因置都司及營州五屯衛，而封皇子權為寧王，調各衛兵往守。

translations.literal: After Feng Sheng defeated Naghachu and withdrew the army, he walled the place, then established the regional command and five Yingzhou garrison guards, enfeoffed the prince Quan as Prince of Ning, and transferred guards' troops to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Sheng shattered Naghachu's forces and marched back, he fortified the site, established the regional command and five Yingzhou agricultural garrisons, enfeoffed Prince Quan as Prince of Ning, and shifted guard units to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 先是，李文忠等取元上都，設開平衛及興和等千戶所，東西各四驛，東接大寧，西接獨石。

translations.literal: Earlier, Li Wenzhong and others had taken the Yuan upper capital and established Kaiping Guard and Xinghe and other thousand-household offices, with four relay stations east and west each; east joining Daning, west joining Dushi.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Wenzhong and others had seized the Yuan Upper Capital and set up Kaiping Guard with Xinghe and other thousand-household posts, four relay stations to east and west, the eastern line linking Daning and the western line Dushi Stone.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，又築東勝城於河州東受降城之東，設十六衛，與大同相望。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Dongcheng was also built east of Shouxiang City on the eastern bank of the Hezhou Shouxiang fort, with sixteen guards established opposite Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25, Dongcheng was also built east of Shouxiangcheng at the eastern Shouxiang Fort on the Hezhou, with sixteen guards positioned to face Datong.

sentences.zh: 自遼以西，數千里聲勢聯絡。

translations.literal: From Liaodong westward, for several thousand li, military presence was linked in coordination.
translations.idiomatic: From Liaodong westward for thousands of li, garrisons and strongpoints now formed a continuous chain.

sentences.zh: 洪熙改元，朔州軍士白榮請還東勝、高山等十衛於故地。

translations.literal: At the change to the Hongxi reign, a soldier of Shuozhou named Bai Rong petitioned to restore Dongsheng, Gaoshan, and ten other guards to their former territories.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hongxi reign began, a Shuozhou garrison soldier named Bai Rong petitioned to return Dongsheng, Gaoshan, and ten other guards to their old posts.

sentences.zh: 興州軍士範濟亦言：朔州、大同、開平、宣府大寧皆籓籬要地，其土可耕，宜遣將率兵，修城堡，廣屯種。

translations.literal: A soldier of Xingzhou named Fan Ji also said: Shuozhou, Datong, Kaiping, Xuanfu, and Daning were all vital shield territories whose soil could be cultivated; generals should be sent with troops to repair castles and expand farm colonies.
translations.idiomatic: A Xingzhou soldier named Fan Ji argued that Shuozhou, Datong, Kaiping, Xuanfu, and Daning were all strategic shield lands fit for tillage and that generals should be sent to rebuild forts and expand garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 皆不能用。

translations.literal: None of these proposals was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: None of these proposals was heeded.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，給事中硃純請修塞垣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, Supervising Secretary Zhu Chun requested repair of the border rampart.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1, supervising secretary Zhu Chun asked to repair the border wall.

sentences.zh: 總兵官譚廣言：「自龍門至獨石及黑峪口五百五十餘里，工作甚難，不若益墩臺□□守。」

translations.literal: Regional Commander Tan Guang said: "From Longmen to Dushi and Heiyukou, more than 550 li—construction would be extremely difficult; it would be better to add beacon towers for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Tan Guang reported: "From Longmen through Dushi and Black Gorge Pass stretches more than 550 li; the earthworks would be arduous. Better to strengthen the beacon-tower line instead.

sentences.zh: 乃增赤城等堡煙墩二十二。

translations.literal: Thereupon twenty-two smoke towers at Chicheng and other forts were added.
translations.idiomatic: The court accordingly added twenty-two smoke beacon towers at Chicheng and neighboring forts.

sentences.zh: 寧夏總兵官史昭言：「所轄屯堡，俱在河外，自河迤東至察罕腦兒，抵綏德州，沙漠曠遠，並無守備。

translations.literal: Ningxia Regional Commander Shi Zhao said: "The garrison farms under my command are all beyond the river; from the river east to Chagan Nur, reaching Suide Prefecture, the desert is vast and there is no defence at all.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia Commander Shi Zhao stated: "All farms under my command lie beyond the Yellow River; east from the river to Chagan Nur and on to Suide the desert is empty of any guard force.

sentences.zh: 請於花馬池築哨馬營。」

translations.literal: Please establish a sentry horse camp at Huamachi.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a mounted sentry camp be built at Huamachi.

sentences.zh: 大同總兵官方政繼以馬營請，欲就半嶺紅寺兒廢營修築。

translations.literal: Datong Regional Commander Fang Zheng likewise petitioned for a horse camp, wishing to rebuild on the abandoned camp at Banling Hongsier.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Commander Fang Zheng followed with a similar horse-camp plan, proposing to refurbish the abandoned post at Banling Hongsier.

sentences.zh: 宣大巡撫都御史李儀以大同平衍，巡哨宜謹，請以副總兵主東路，參將主西路，而迤北則屬之總兵官都指揮。

translations.literal: Xuan-Da Grand Coordinator Li Yi, because Datong terrain was level, said patrols should be careful; the deputy commander should control the eastern route, the assistant commander the western route, while the northern sector should fall under the regional commander and commanding officer.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan-Da Grand Coordinator Li Yi judged that Datong's open terrain required stricter scouting: the deputy commander should hold the east road, the brigade commander the west, and the northern sector answer to the regional commander.

sentences.zh: 並如議行。

translations.literal: All were approved and implemented as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved each proposal as submitted.

sentences.zh: 後三年，詔塞紫荊關諸隘口，增守備軍。

translations.literal: Three years later, an edict blocked the passes at Zijing Pass and other defiles and increased frontier garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later an edict ordered Zijing Pass and other defiles sealed and reinforcement troops added.

sentences.zh: 時瓦剌漸強，從成國公硃勇請也。

translations.literal: At that time the Oirats were growing stronger; this followed a request from the Duke of Cheng, Zhu Yong.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirats were waxing in strength at the time, and the order followed a memorial from Duke of Cheng Zhu Yong.

sentences.zh: 既而也先入塞，英宗陷於土木。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Esen invaded the frontier, and Emperor Yingzong fell captive at Tumu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Esen broke through the frontier and Emperor Yingzong was captured at Tumu Fort.

sentences.zh: 景帝即位，十餘年間，邊患日多，索來、毛裡孩、阿羅出之屬，相繼入犯，無寧歲。

translations.literal: After Emperor Jing took the throne, over more than ten years frontier troubles multiplied daily; Suolai, Maolihai, Aluochu, and their like invaded in succession, and there was no peaceful year.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jing Emperor's accession, border alarms mounted year upon year as Suolai, Maolihai, Aluochu, and others raided in turn, leaving no season of rest.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，延綏總兵官張傑言：「延慶等境廣袤千里，所轄二十五營堡，每處僅一二百人，難以應敵，宜選精銳九千為六哨，分屯府谷、神木二縣，龍州、榆林二城，高家、安邊二堡，庶緩急有備。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua, Yansui Regional Commander Zhang Jie said: "The Yanqing sector stretches a thousand li, with twenty-five camps and forts under command, each with only one or two hundred men—too few to meet the enemy; it is appropriate to select nine thousand elite troops for six outposts divided among Fugu and Shenmu counties, Longzhou and Yulin cities, and Gaojia and Anbian forts, so that urgent need may find a reserve.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 1, Yansui Commander Zhang Jie reported that his thousand-li Yanqing sector held twenty-five camps and forts with only a hundred or two men each—far too few to fight. He proposed nine thousand picked troops in six detachments posted at Fugu, Shenmu, Longzhou, Yulin, Gaojia, and Anbian so reserves would be at hand.

sentences.zh: 又請分佈鄜、慶防秋軍二千餘人於沿邊要害。

translations.literal: Also request distributing more than two thousand autumn-guard troops from Fu and Qing along vital border points."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that more than two thousand autumn-guard troops from Fu and Qing be stationed at key passes.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 七年，延綏巡撫都御史餘子俊大築邊城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yansui Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun undertook major construction of the border wall.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7, Yansui Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun launched a great border-wall project.

sentences.zh: 先是，東勝設衛守在河外，榆林治綏德。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Dongcheng Guard was stationed beyond the river, Yulin administration was at Suide.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Dongsheng Guard had stood beyond the river while Yulin's seat remained at Suide.

sentences.zh: 後東勝內遷，失險，捐米脂、魚河地幾三百里。

translations.literal: Later Dongcheng was moved inland, losing the strategic terrain and ceding nearly three hundred li of Mizhi and Yuhe territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Dongsheng was pulled back inland the terrain's advantage was lost and nearly three hundred li around Mizhi and Yuhe were surrendered.

sentences.zh: 正統間，鎮守都督王禎始築榆林城，建緣邊營堡二十四，歲調延安、綏德、慶陽三衛軍分戍。

translations.literal: In the Zhengtong era Regional Commander Wang Zhen first walled Yulin city, built twenty-four frontier camps and forts, and each year rotated troops from Yan'an, Suide, and Qingyang guards for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhengtong, Regional Commander Wang Zhen first walled Yulin and raised twenty-four border camps and forts, rotating garrison duty annually among troops from Yan'an, Suide, and Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 天順中，阿羅出入河套駐牧，每引諸部內犯。

translations.literal: In the Tianshun period Aluo and his followers entered and grazed in the Ordos bend, each year leading tribes inward to raid.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianshun reign Aluo and others pastured in the Ordos bend and yearly led allied tribes on raids inland.

sentences.zh: 至是，子俊乃徙治榆林。

translations.literal: At this time Zijun then moved the seat of government to Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zijun now transferred the prefectural seat to Yulin itself.

sentences.zh: 由黃甫川西至定邊營千二百餘里，墩堡相望，橫截套口，內復塹山堙谷，曰夾道，東抵偏頭，西終寧、固，風土勁悍，將勇士力，北人呼為橐駝城。

translations.literal: From Huangfuchuan west to Dingbianying for more than 1,200 li, beacon forts faced one another across the bend, cutting the mouth of the bend; within, mountains were trenched and valleys filled in to make a "flanking track" east to Piankou and west to Ning and Gu; the people were hardy and generals and troops valiant—northerners called it Luotuo Castle.
translations.idiomatic: From Huangfuchuan west to Dingbianying for 1,200 li beacon towers stood in sight of one another, sealing the bend's mouth; inside, trenches cut ridges and blocked valleys into a "flank lane" running east to Piankou and west through Ning and Gu. The region bred fierce men and bold commanders—northerners nicknamed the circuit "Camel City."

sentences.zh: 十二年，兵部侍郎滕昭、英國公張懋條上邊備，言：「居庸關、黃花鎮、喜峯口、古北口、燕河營有團營馬步軍萬五千人戍守，請益軍五千，分駐永平、密雲以策應遼東。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Vice Minister of War Teng Zhao and the Duke of England Zhang Mao submitted border-defense plans, saying: "At Juyong Pass, Huanghuazhen, Xifeng Pass, Gubeikou, and Yanheying there are 15,000 cavalry and infantry in rotating camp garrison—please add 5,000 more distributed at Yongping and Miyun to support Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12, War Ministry Vice Minister Teng Zhao and Duke of England Zhang Mao submitted border plans noting 15,000 rotating camp troops at Juyong, Huanghuazhen, Xifengkou, Gubeikou, and Yanheying and asking for 5,000 more at Yongping and Miyun to cover Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 涼州鎮番、莊浪、賀蘭山迤西，從雪山過河，南通靖虜，直至臨、鞏，俱敵入犯之路，請調陝西官軍，益以甘、涼、臨、鞏、秦、平、河、洮兵，戍安定、會寧，遇警截擊；

translations.literal: West of Zhenfan, Zhuanglang, and Helan Mountain, crossing the snow range to the river, reaching south to Jingfu and on to Lin and Gong—all are enemy invasion routes; please transfer Shaanxi official troops, supplemented by troops from Gan, Liang, Lin, Gong, Qin, Ping, He, and Tao, to garrison Anding and Huining, intercepting when alarms arise;
translations.idiomatic: From Zhenfan and Zhuanglang west of Helanshan, crossing the snow mountains to the river and south through Jingfu to Lin and Gong, all are enemy avenues—transfer Shaanxi regulars reinforced from Gan, Liang, Lin, Gong, Qin, Ping, He, and Tao to hold Anding and Huining for interception when alarms sound;

sentences.zh: 以涼州銳士五千，扼要屯駐，彼此策應。」

translations.literal: with 5,000 crack troops from Liangzhou posted at vital points to support one another.
translations.idiomatic: and station 5,000 Liangzhou veterans at choke points to answer one another.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，敕各邊軍士，每歲九月至明年三月，俱常操練，仍以操過軍馬及風雪免日奏報。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, border troops were ordered: from September each year through March of the following year all should train regularly, while still reporting horses drilled and exempting days of wind and snow from daily memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21, frontier troops were ordered to train constantly from the ninth month through the third month of the following year, while still memorializing trained horses and excusing blizzard days from routine reports.

sentences.zh: 邊備頗修飭。

translations.literal: Border defenses were considerably tightened.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier readiness was noticeably tightened.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年，設固原鎮。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongzhi, Guyuan garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 14 the Guyuan command was established.

sentences.zh: 先是，固原為內地，所備惟靖虜。

translations.literal: Earlier Guyuan had been interior territory and only Jingfu was prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Guyuan had lain deep inside the line and only Jingfu was fortified.

sentences.zh: 及火篩入據河套，遂為敵沖。

translations.literal: When Huoshai seized and held the Ordos bend, it became an enemy thoroughfare.
translations.idiomatic: Once Huoshai seized pasture in the Ordos bend, the region became a principal enemy corridor.

sentences.zh: 乃改平涼之開成縣為固原州，隸以四衛，設總制府，總陝西三邊軍務。

translations.literal: Then Kaicheng County in Pingliang was transformed into Guyuan Prefecture, subordinated to four guards, with a general commandery established to oversee Shaanxi Three Borders military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Kaicheng county in Pingliang was then elevated to Guyuan prefecture, four guards placed under it, and a Three Borders headquarters installed to coordinate Shaanxi's western commands.

sentences.zh: 是時陝邊惟甘肅稍安，而哈密屢為土魯番所擾，乃敕修嘉峪關。

translations.literal: At this time only Gansu on the Shaanxi frontier was somewhat calm, but Hami was repeatedly harassed by Turfan, so an edict ordered repair of Jiayu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: By then only the Gansu sector of the Shaanxi front was comparatively quiet; Hami suffered repeated Turfan raids, and the throne ordered Jiayu Pass repaired.

sentences.zh: 正德元年春，總制三邊都御史楊一清請復守東勝：「因河為固，東接大同，西屬寧夏，使河套千里沃壤，歸我耕牧，則陝右猶可息肩」。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Zhengde, Three Borders Grand Coordinator Yang Yiqing petitioned to restore garrison at Dongcheng: "Using the river as fortification, joining east to Datong and west to Ningxia, we could recover the thousand-li fertile soil of the Ordos bend for our farming and herding, and Shaanxi's right wing could then rest its shoulders."
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhengde year 1, Three Borders Coordinator Yang Yiqing petitioned to reoccupy Dongsheng: "With the river as rampart, linking Datong in the east and Ningxia in the west, the thousand-li Ordos heartland could again feed our fields and herds and ease pressure on western Shaanxi."

sentences.zh: 因上修築定邊營等六事。

translations.literal: Thereupon he submitted six items for repairing Dingbianying and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He followed with six specific proposals to rebuild Dingbianying and related works.

sentences.zh: 帝可其奏。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his memorial.

sentences.zh: 旋以忤中官劉瑾罷，所築塞垣僅四十餘里而已。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was dismissed for offending the eunuch Liu Jin; only forty-odd li of border wall were actually built.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon cashiered for offending eunuch Liu Jin, and scarcely forty li of border rampart were ever finished.

sentences.zh: 武宗好武，邊將江彬等得幸，遼東、宣府、大同、延綏四鎮軍多內調，又以京軍六千與宣府軍六千春秋番換。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong loved military affairs; frontier generals such as Jiang Bin won favor; troops from the four garrisons of Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, and Yansui were often shifted inland, while six thousand capital troops and six thousand Xuanfu troops were rotated seasonally each spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuzong Emperor delighted in military display; border commanders such as Jiang Bin gained favor; the four Liaodong, Xuanfu, Datong, and Yansui commands were stripped of troops for the interior, while 6,000 capital soldiers and 6,000 Xuanfu troops rotated seasonally.

sentences.zh: 十三年，頒定宣、大、延綏三鎮應援節度：敵不渡河，則延綏聽調於宣、大；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year regulations were issued for coordinated relief among Xuan, Da, and Yansui garrisons: if the enemy did not cross the river, Yansui followed Xuan and Da's command;
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 contingency orders fixed Xuan, Da, and Yansui coordination: if raiders did not cross the river, Yansui answered to Xuanfu and Datong;

sentences.zh: 渡河，則宣、大聽調於延綏。

translations.literal: if they crossed the river, Xuan and Da answered to Yansui.
translations.idiomatic: if they crossed, Xuanfu and Datong answered to Yansui.

sentences.zh: 從兵部尚書王瓊議也。

translations.literal: This followed the proposal of Minister of War Wang Qiong.
translations.idiomatic: The arrangement followed War Minister Wang Qiong's plan.

sentences.zh: 初，大寧之棄，以其地畀朵顏、福餘、泰寧三衛，蓋兀良哈歸附者也。

translations.literal: Earlier when Daning was abandoned, its territory was granted to the three guards of Doyan, Fuyu, and Taining—these were Uriankhai who had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When Daning was abandoned earlier, its lands had been granted to the Doyan, Fuyu, and Taining guards—Uriankhai tribes who had submitted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遂不靖。

translations.literal: Before long they became restive.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they ceased to be peaceful.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘗因田獵，親率師敗之，自是畏服。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong once on a hunting expedition personally led troops and defeated them; thereafter they were awed and submissive.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor once personally led a hunt that routed them, and thereafter they held the court in wary respect.

sentences.zh: 故喜峯、密雲止設都指揮鎮守。

translations.literal: Therefore only regional-commander posts were set at Xifeng and Miyun for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hence only regional-commander posts guarded Xifengkou and Miyun.

sentences.zh: 土木之變，頗傳三衛助逆，後因添設太監參將等官。

translations.literal: At the Tumu crisis it was widely rumored that the three guards aided the enemy; afterward eunuch supervising generals and the like were added.
translations.idiomatic: After Tumu, rumor held that the three guards had sided with the enemy, and supervisory eunuchs and assistant commanders were soon added.

sentences.zh: 至是，朵顏獨盛，情叵測。

translations.literal: By now only Doyan was strong, and its intentions were hard to read.
translations.idiomatic: By this time only Doyan had grown powerful, its intentions increasingly opaque.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，御史丘養浩請復小河等關於外地，以扼其要。

translations.literal: Early in Jiajing, Censor Qiu Yanghao petitioned to restore passes such as Xiaohe on the outer line to seize strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiajing reign, Censor Qiu Yanghao asked to reopen outer-line passes such as Xiaohe to choke enemy movement.

sentences.zh: 又請多鑄火器，給沿邊州縣，募商□粟，實各邊衛所。

translations.literal: He also asked to cast more firearms for distribution to frontier prefectures and counties, recruit merchants to transport grain, and fill each border guard and post.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged casting more firearms for frontier counties, recruiting merchants to haul grain, and stocking every border guard depot.

sentences.zh: 詔皆行之。

translations.literal: Edicts ordered all these carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts ordered each measure implemented.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖時，以邊軍屯田不足，召商輸邊粟而與之鹽。

translations.literal: Earlier in the Taizu era, because border garrison farms were insufficient, merchants were summoned to transport frontier grain in exchange for salt.
translations.idiomatic: Under the founding emperor, when garrison farms fell short, merchants were invited to ship grain to the border in return for salt certificates.

sentences.zh: 富商大賈悉自出財力，募民墾田塞下，故邊儲不匱。

translations.literal: Great merchants all supplied funds themselves and recruited people to open farms below the passes, so frontier stores were not exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy merchants financed their own colonies and recruited settlers to till the northern marches, so frontier granaries did not run dry.

sentences.zh: 弘治時，戶部尚書葉淇始變法，令商納銀太倉，分給各邊。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi era Minister of Revenue Ye Qi first changed the method, ordering merchants to pay silver to the Grand Canal granary for distribution to each border sector.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongzhi, Revenue Minister Ye Qi altered the system, requiring merchants to pay silver into the Taicang granary for allocation to the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 商皆撤業歸，邊地荒蕪，米粟踴貴，邊軍遂日困。

translations.literal: Merchants all withdrew from business and returned home; border lands fell wasteful, grain prices soared, and frontier troops grew daily more destitute.
translations.idiomatic: Traders abandoned their contracts and went home; border farmland lay fallow, grain prices soared, and garrison troops grew poorer by the day.

sentences.zh: 十一年，御史徐汝圭條上邊防兵食，謂「延綏宜漕石州、保德之粟，自黃河而上，楚粟由鄖陽，汴粟由陝、洛，沔粟由漢中，以達陝右。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Censor Xu Rugui submitted a plan on frontier troops and provisions, saying: "For Yansui, grain from Shizhou and Baode should be shipped by canal up the Yellow River; Chu grain through Yunyang; Bian grain through Shaan and Luo; Mian grain through Hanzhong—to reach western Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, Censor Xu Rugui outlined frontier grain policy: Yansui should receive Shizhou and Baode grain by Yellow River transport; Chu grain via Yunyang; Kaifeng grain via Shaanxi and Luoyang; Hanzhong grain via the Han valley—all to feed western Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 宣、大產二麥，宜多方收□。

translations.literal: Xuan and Da produce two kinds of wheat and should collect extensively in many ways.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu and Datong grow two-grain wheat and should be urged to gather and store it by every available means.

sentences.zh: 紫荊、倒馬、白羊等關，宜招商賃車運」。

translations.literal: At Zijing, Daoma, and Baiyang passes, merchants should be recruited to hire carts for transport."
translations.idiomatic: At Zijing, Daoma, and Baiyang passes, merchants should be enlisted to contract cart transport."

sentences.zh: 又請「以宣府遊兵駐右衛懷來，以援大同。

translations.literal: "Also request stationing Xuanfu mobile troops at Youwei Huailai to support Datong.
translations.idiomatic: "Also post Xuanfu mobile troops at Youwei and Huailai to relieve Datong.

sentences.zh: 選補遊兵於順聖西城為臨期應援，永寧等處遊兵衛宣府，備調遣。

translations.literal: Select and replenish mobile troops at Shuningsheng West City for emergency support; mobile troops at Yongning and elsewhere should guard Xuanfu for deployment.
translations.idiomatic: Refit mobile detachments at Shuningsheng's western city as a rapid reserve; Yongning and similar posts should hold mobile troops under Xuanfu command.

sentences.zh: 直隸八府召募勇敢團練，赴邊關遠近警急。

translations.literal: Eight Zhili prefectures should recruit bold militia companies for urgent alarms near and far along the border passes.
translations.idiomatic: Eight metropolitan prefectures should recruit hardy militia companies to answer alarms along the passes, near and far.

sentences.zh: 榆林、山、陝遊兵，於本處策應」。

translations.literal: Yulin and Shan-Shaan mobile troops should provide local mutual support."
translations.idiomatic: Yulin and Shaanxi mobile troops should give one another local support."

sentences.zh: 報可，亦未能行也。

translations.literal: Approval was granted, yet implementation never followed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved, yet scarcely anything was carried out.

sentences.zh: 十八年，移三邊制府鎮花馬池。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Three Borders headquarters was moved to Huamachi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the Three Borders headquarters was shifted to Huamachi.

sentences.zh: 是時，俺答諸部強橫，屢深入大同、太原之境，晉陽南北，煙火蕭然。

translations.literal: At that time Altan and his tribes were powerful and repeatedly penetrated deep into Datong and Taiyuan; north and south of Jinyang, smoke signals lay bare everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Altan's confederation was then at its height, raiding deep into Datong and Taiyuan until north and south of Jinyang the country stood deserted under signal smoke.

sentences.zh: 巡撫都御史陳講請「以兵六千戍老營堡東界之長峪，以山西兵守大同。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Chen Jiang petitioned: "Post six thousand troops to guard Changyu east of Laoying Fort; hold Datong with Shanxi troops.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Chen Jiang proposed posting six thousand men at Changyu east of Laoying Fort while Shanxi troops held Datong.

sentences.zh: 三關形勢，寧武為中路，莫要於神池，偏頭為西路，莫要於老營堡，皆宜改設參將。

translations.literal: Among the Three Passes' terrain, Ningwu is the center and nothing matters more than Shenchi; Piankou is the west road and nothing matters more than Laoying Fort—all should receive newly appointed brigade commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Three Passes, Ningwu forms the central axis with Shenchi as its key; Piankou heads the western road with Laoying Fort paramount—each should gain a dedicated brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 雁門為東路，莫要於北樓諸口，宜增設把總、指揮。

translations.literal: Yanmen is the eastern road; nothing matters more than the Beilou passes—assistant commanders and directors should be added.
translations.idiomatic: Yanmen commands the eastern road, where the Beilou defiles are decisive—add platoon leaders and directors there.

sentences.zh: 而移神池守備於利民堡，老營堡遊擊於八角所，各增軍設備」。

translations.literal: Move the Shenchi garrison command to Limin Fort and Laoying's mobile detachment to Bajiao Station, increasing troops and equipment at each."
translations.idiomatic: Shift the Shenchi garrison to Limin Fort and Laoying's mobile unit to Bajiao Station, augmenting men and gear at both."

sentences.zh: 帝悉許之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved every item.

sentences.zh: 規畫雖密，然兵將率怯弱，其健者僅能自守而已。

translations.literal: Though the plans were thorough, officers and troops were mostly timid; even the able could barely defend themselves.
translations.idiomatic: For all the careful planning, commanders and men were largely timid; even the stouthearted could barely hold their posts.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，詔宣府兵乘塞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, an edict ordered Xuanfu troops to man the border line in season.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 an edict ordered Xuanfu troops to take up seasonal positions along the wall.

sentences.zh: 舊制，總兵夏秋間分駐邊堡，謂之暗伏。

translations.literal: Under the old system, the regional commander between summer and autumn divided residence among border forts, called "hidden deployment."
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rule, from summer into autumn the commander quartered among border forts in what was called "secret encampment."

sentences.zh: 至是，有司建議，入秋悉令赴邊，分地拒守，至九月中罷歸，犒以帑金。

translations.literal: Now the responsible offices proposed that on entering autumn all should proceed to the frontier, divide territory for defense, withdraw in the ninth month, and be rewarded with treasury silver.
translations.idiomatic: Offices now proposed that with autumn every unit march to the line, hold assigned sectors until the ninth month, then withdraw with treasury rewards.

sentences.zh: 久之，以勞費罷。

translations.literal: After a long time, this was abolished because of labor and expense.
translations.idiomatic: In time the practice was dropped as too costly and burdensome.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，巡按山西御史陳豪言：「敵三犯山西，傷殘百萬，費餉銀六十億，曾無尺寸功。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Shanxi touring censor Chen Hao said: "The enemy has thrice invaded Shanxi, maiming a million people and spending six billion taels of silver in provisions, yet not an inch of achievement.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24, Shanxi touring censor Chen Hao reported: "The enemy has raided Shanxi three times, leaving a million people maimed and sixty million taels in pay spent, without gaining a single foot of ground.

sentences.zh: 請定計決戰，盡復套地。」

translations.literal: Please fix a plan for decisive battle and fully recover the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: Settle on a decisive campaign and recover the entire Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 明年，敵犯延安，總督三邊侍郎曾銑力主復套，條上十八事。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy invaded Yan'an; Three Borders Vice Minister Zeng Xian strongly advocated recovering the bend and submitted eighteen items."
translations.idiomatic: The following year raiders struck Yan'an; Three Borders Vice Minister Zeng Xian pressed hard to retake the bend and memorialized eighteen measures."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 大學士嚴嵩窺帝意憚兵，且欲殺舊閣臣夏言，因劾銑，並言誅死，自是無敢言邊事者。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yan Song perceived the emperor feared war and wished to kill the former grand secretary Xia Yan; he therefore impeached Xian and had him executed, after which none dared speak of border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yan Song saw that the emperor shrank from war and wanted the former grand secretary Xia Yan dead; he impeached Zeng Xian and had him executed, and thereafter no one dared raise frontier policy again.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，俺答攻古北口，從間道黃榆溝入，直薄東直門，諸將不敢戰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Altan attacked Gubeikou, entered by the bypath of Huangyu Gully, and pressed straight to Dongzhimen; the generals did not dare fight.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 Altan struck Gubeikou, slipped through Huangyu Gully by a side path, and drove straight to Dongzhimen while the generals refused battle.

sentences.zh: 敵退，大將軍仇鸞力主貢市之議。

translations.literal: After the enemy withdrew, Grand General Qiu Luan strongly advocated the tribute-market policy.
translations.idiomatic: When the raiders withdrew, Grand General Qiu Luan pressed the tribute-market policy.

sentences.zh: 明年，開馬市於大同，然寇掠如故。

translations.literal: The next year a horse market was opened at Datong, yet raiding continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: The next year a horse market opened at Datong, but plunder continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 又明年，馬市罷。

translations.literal: The year after that the horse market was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the market was shut down.

sentences.zh: 先是翁萬達之總督宣、大也，籌邊事甚悉。

translations.literal: Earlier when Weng Wanda was grand coordinator of Xuan and Da, he planned border affairs very thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Weng Wanda governed Xuanfu and Datong, he had laid out frontier affairs in meticulous detail.

sentences.zh: 其言曰：「山西保德州河岸，東盡老營堡，凡二百五十四里。

translations.literal: He said: "From the Baode Prefecture bank in Shanxi east to Laoying Fort, altogether 254 li.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "From the Baode prefecture bank in Shanxi east to Laoying Fort measures 254 li.

sentences.zh: 西路丫角山迤北而來，歷中北路，抵東路之東陽河鎮口臺，凡六百四十七里。

translations.literal: The western route from Yajiao Mountain northward through the central-north road to the eastern route's Dongyanghe Zhenkou Platform, altogether 647 li.
translations.idiomatic: The western line runs north from Yajiao Mountain through the central-north road to the eastern route's Dongyanghe Zhenkou platform—647 li.

sentences.zh: 宣府西路，西陽河迤東，歷中北路，抵東路之永寧四海冶，凡一千二十三里。

translations.literal: The Xuanfu western route from Xiyang River east through the central-north road to the eastern route's Yongning Sihaiye, altogether 1,023 li.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu's western line runs east from Xiyang River through the central-north road to Yongning Sihaiye on the eastern route—1,023 li.

sentences.zh: 皆逼臨巨寇，險在外者，所謂極邊也。

translations.literal: All press upon great enemies; where danger lies outside, this is called the outermost border.
translations.idiomatic: All face major enemies directly; where the danger lies beyond the wall is the outer frontier.

sentences.zh: 老營堡轉南而東，歷寧武、雁門、北樓至平刑關盡境，約八百里。

translations.literal: From Laoying Fort turning south and east through Ningwu, Yanmen, and Beilou to the full extent of Pingxing Pass, about 800 li.
translations.idiomatic: From Laoying Fort south and east through Ningwu, Yanmen, and Beilou to the limit of Pingxing Pass is roughly 800 li.

sentences.zh: 又轉南而東，為保定界，歷龍泉、倒馬、紫荊、吳王口、插箭嶺、浮圖峪至沿河口，約一千七十餘里。

translations.literal: Turning again south and east into Baoding territory through Longquan, Daoma, Zijing, Wuwangkou, Chajian Ridge, and Futuyu to Yanhekou, about 1,070-odd li.
translations.idiomatic: Turning south and east into Baoding through Longquan, Daoma, Zijing, Wuwangkou, Chajian Ridge, and Futuyu to Yanhekou adds more than 1,070 li.

sentences.zh: 又東北為順天界，歷高崖、白羊，抵居庸關，約一百八十餘里。

translations.literal: Again northeast into Shuntian territory through Gaoya and Baiyang to Juyong Pass, about 180-odd li.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast into Shuntian through Gaoya and Baiyang to Juyong Pass is another 180-odd li.

sentences.zh: 皆峻嶺層岡，險在內者，所謂次邊也。

translations.literal: All are steep ridges and layered hills; where danger lies within, this is called the secondary border.
translations.idiomatic: These are all steep ridges and layered hills; where the danger lies inside the line is the inner frontier.

sentences.zh: 敵犯山西必自大同，入紫荊必自宣府，未有不經外邊能入內邊者。」

translations.literal: Enemies invading Shanxi must come through Datong; entering Zijing must come through Xuanfu—none can enter the inner border without passing the outer border.
translations.idiomatic: Raids into Shanxi must come through Datong; entry at Zijing must come through Xuanfu—no enemy reaches the inner line without crossing the outer line.

sentences.zh: 乃請修築宣、大邊牆千餘里，烽堠三百六十三所。

translations.literal: He therefore requested building the Xuan-Da border wall for more than a thousand li and 363 beacon towers."
translations.idiomatic: He therefore asked to build more than a thousand li of Xuan-Da border wall and 363 beacon towers."

sentences.zh: 後以通市故，不復防，遂半為敵毀。

translations.literal: "Later, because of opening markets, defense was no longer maintained, and half was destroyed by the enemy."
translations.idiomatic: "Later, trade openings led to neglected defense, and the enemy destroyed half the works."

sentences.zh: 至是，兵部請敕邊將修補。

translations.literal: "At this time the Ministry of War requested an edict for frontier generals to repair it."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the War Ministry asked the throne to order frontier commanders to repair the damage."

sentences.zh: 科臣又言，垣上宜築高臺，建廬以棲火器。

translations.literal: "Censorial officials also said high platforms should be built atop the wall and lodges erected to house firearms."
translations.idiomatic: "Censors also urged high platforms atop the rampart and lodges to house firearms."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 時俺答益強，朵顏三衛為之向道，遼、薊、宣、大連歲被兵。

translations.literal: "At that time Altan grew stronger; the three Doyan guards guided him; Liaodong, Ji, Xuan, and Da suffered raids year after year."
translations.idiomatic: "Altan was growing stronger; the three Doyan guards served as his guides; Liaodong, Jizhou, Xuanfu, and Datong were raided year after year."

sentences.zh: 三十四年，總督軍務兵部尚書楊博，既解大同右衛圍，因築牛心諸堡，修烽堠二千八百有奇。

translations.literal: "In the thirty-fourth year Yang Bo, Minister of War supervising military affairs, after relieving the siege of Datong Right Guard, built Niuxin and other forts and repaired 2,800-odd beacon towers."
translations.idiomatic: "In year 34 War Minister Yang Bo, after lifting the siege of Datong Right Guard, built Niuxin and other forts and restored more than 2,800 beacon towers."

sentences.zh: 宣、大間稍寧息，而薊鎮之患不已。

translations.literal: "Between Xuan and Da there was slight calm, but the troubles of the Ji garrison did not cease."
translations.idiomatic: "Xuanfu and Datong gained a brief respite, but the Jizhou command's troubles continued."

sentences.zh: 薊之稱鎮，自二十七年始。

translations.literal: "Ji was first called a garrison from the twenty-seventh year."
translations.idiomatic: "Jizhou first became a named command in year 27."

sentences.zh: 時鎮兵未練，因詔各邊入衛兵往戍。

translations.literal: "At that time the garrison troops were untrained, so an edict ordered frontier interior guards to go garrison there."
translations.idiomatic: "Its troops were then untrained, so the court ordered interior guards from other frontiers to rotate in."

sentences.zh: 既而兵部言：「大同之三邊，陝西之固原，宣府之長安嶺，延綏之夾牆，皆據重險，惟薊獨無。

translations.literal: Soon the Ministry of War said: "Datong's Three Borders, Shaanxi's Guyuan, Xuanfu's Chang'an Ridge, and Yansui's Flank Wall all hold vital terrain—only Ji has none.
translations.idiomatic: The War Ministry soon noted: "Datong's Three Borders, Shaanxi's Guyuan, Xuanfu's Chang'an Ridge, and Yansui's flank wall all hold commanding ground—only Jizhou does not.

sentences.zh: 渤海所南，山陵東，有蘇家口，至寨籬村七十里，地形平漫，宜築牆建臺，設兵守，與京軍相夾制。」

translations.literal: South of Bohai, east of the hills, from Sujiakou to Zhailicun for seventy li the terrain is level and open; walls and towers should be built and troops posted to check the enemy together with capital troops.
translations.idiomatic: South of Bohai and east of the hills, from Sujiakou to Zhailicun for seventy li of open ground, walls and towers should rise with garrisons to brace the capital forces.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted."
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved."

sentences.zh: 時兵力孱弱，有警徵召四集，而議者惟以據險為事，無敢言戰者。

translations.literal: "At that time military strength was weak; when alarms arose troops were summoned from all sides, yet debaters only talked of holding terrain and none dared speak of fighting."
translations.idiomatic: "Forces were then feeble; alarms still drew troops from every quarter, yet counsellors spoke only of holding ground and none dared urge battle."

sentences.zh: 其後薊鎮入衛兵，俱聽宣、大督、撫調遣，防禦益疏。

translations.literal: "Later the Ji garrison interior guards all obeyed Xuan-Da coordinators' deployment, and defense grew laxer."
translations.idiomatic: "Later Jizhou's interior guards answered to Xuan-Da coordinators, and the line grew still thinner."

sentences.zh: 朵顏遂乘虛歲入。

translations.literal: "Doyan then seized the opening to enter every year."
translations.idiomatic: "Doyan then exploited the gap to raid every year."

sentences.zh: 三十七年，諸鎮建議，各練本鎮戍卒，可省徵發費十之六。

translations.literal: "In the thirty-seventh year the garrisons proposed each training its own garrison soldiers, which could save six-tenths of mobilization costs."
translations.idiomatic: "In year 37 the commands proposed training their own garrison troops, saving six-tenths of mobilization expense."

sentences.zh: 然戍卒選懦不任戰，歲練亦費萬餘，而臨事徵發如故。

translations.literal: "Yet the selected garrison soldiers were timid and unfit for battle; annual training still cost more than ten thousand, while emergency mobilization remained as before."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet the men chosen were timid and unfit for battle; yearly drill still cost over ten thousand taels while emergency levies continued unchanged."

sentences.zh: 隆慶間，總兵官戚繼光總理薊、遼，任練兵事，因請調浙兵三千人以倡勇敢。

translations.literal: "In the Longqing era Regional Commander Qi Jiguang oversaw Ji and Liao and took charge of training, requesting three thousand Zhe troops to set an example of courage."
translations.idiomatic: "Under Longqing, Commander Qi Jiguang oversaw Jizhou and Liaodong, took charge of drill, and asked for three thousand Zhejiang veterans to model courage."

sentences.zh: 及至，待命於郊，自朝至日中，天雨，軍士跬步不移，邊將大駭。

translations.literal: "When they arrived and waited in the suburbs from morning to noon in the rain, the soldiers did not move a step; frontier generals were greatly astonished."
translations.idiomatic: "When they arrived and stood in the suburbs from morning to noon in rain without shifting a step, border commanders were astonished."

sentences.zh: 自是薊兵以精整稱。

translations.literal: "From then on Ji troops were famed for being drilled and orderly."
translations.idiomatic: "Thereafter Jizhou troops were famed for discipline."

sentences.zh: 俺答已通貢，封順義王，其子孫襲封者累世。

translations.literal: Altan had already accepted tribute and been enfeoffed Prince of Shunyi; his descendants inherited the title for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Altan had already accepted tribute and been enfeoffed Prince of Shunyi, and his line held the title for generations.

sentences.zh: 迨萬曆之季，西部遂不競，而土蠻部落虎燉兔、炒花、宰賽、□爰兔輩，東西煽動，將士疲於奔命，未嘗得安枕也。

translations.literal: By the late Wanli era the western tribes were no longer competitive, but Tumen tribes such as Huchuntu, Chaohua, Zaisai, and De'ayu stirred trouble east and west; officers and soldiers were worn out running to and fro and never slept in peace.
translations.idiomatic: By late Wanli the western tribes had faded, but Tumen bands such as Huchuntu, Chaohua, Zaisai, and De'ayu stirred raids east and west until officers and men were exhausted and never slept easy.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖沿邊設衛，惟土著兵及有罪謫戍者。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Taizu emperor established guards along the border with only native troops and those banished for crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Under the founding emperor, frontier guards held only native troops and men banished for crimes.

sentences.zh: 遇有警，調他衛軍往戍，謂之客兵。

translations.literal: When alarms arose, troops from other guards were transferred to garrison—called guest troops.
translations.idiomatic: When alarms arose, troops from other guards were rotated in as guest detachments.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，始命內地軍番戍，謂之邊班。

translations.literal: In the Yongle era interior troops were first ordered to rotate in garrison—called border shifts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongle, interior units were first ordered to rotate to the border in frontier shifts.

sentences.zh: 其後佔役逃亡之數多，乃有召募，有改撥，有修守民兵、土兵，而邊防日益壞。

translations.literal: Later, because many were taken for corvée labor or fled, there came recruitment, reassignment, repair of militia and native troops, and border defense daily worsened.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as corvée drafts and desertions mounted, recruitment, reassignment, militia, and native levies multiplied while the frontier daily worsened.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，宣府屯守官軍殆十萬。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu era Xuanfu garrison official troops numbered nearly one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongwu, Xuanfu's registered garrison troops neared one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 正統、景泰間，已不及額。

translations.literal: In the Zhengtong and Jingtai eras they already fell short of quota.
translations.idiomatic: By Zhengtong and Jingtai they already fell below establishment.

sentences.zh: 弘治、正德以後，官軍實有者僅六萬六千九百有奇，而召募與士兵居其半。

translations.literal: After Hongzhi and Zhengde, actual official troops numbered only 66,900-odd, while recruits and militia made up half.
translations.idiomatic: After Hongzhi and Zhengde only 66,900-odd regulars remained on the rolls, while recruits and militia made up half.

sentences.zh: 他鎮率視此。

translations.literal: Other garrisons generally followed this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Other commands followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 正統初，山西、河南班軍守偏頭、大同、宣府塞，不得代。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengtong, Shanxi and Henan shift troops garrisoned Piankou, Datong, and Xuanfu passes and could not be replaced.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhengtong, Shanxi and Henan shift troops held Piankou, Datong, and Xuanfu and could not rotate home.

sentences.zh: 巡撫于謙言：「每歲九月至二月，水冷草枯，敵騎出沒，乘障卒宜多。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Yu Qian said: "From September to February, when water is cold and grass withered, enemy cavalry come and go; wall-guard soldiers should be numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Yu Qian argued: "From the ninth month through the second, when water turns cold and grass dies, enemy horsemen roam freely; wall guards should be numerous.

sentences.zh: 若三月至八月，邊守自足。

translations.literal: From March to August the border garrison suffices by itself.
translations.idiomatic: From the third month through the eighth the border garrison can manage alone.

sentences.zh: 乞將兩班軍，每歲一班，如期放遣。」

translations.literal: Request that the two shift corps each year release one shift on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the two shift corps release one shift each year on schedule.

sentences.zh: 甘肅總兵官蔣貴又言：「沿邊墩臺，守了軍更番有例，惟坐事謫發者不許，困苦甚。

translations.literal: Gansu Regional Commander Jiang Gui also said: "Along the border beacon towers, garrison soldiers rotate by rule, but only those banished for offenses are not allowed—their hardship is extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu Commander Jiang Gui added: "Along the beacon line garrison troops rotate by rule, but men banished for offenses are denied rotation and suffer greatly.

sentences.zh: 乞如例踐更。」

translations.literal: Request that they rotate according to rule.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that they be allowed regular rotation."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，山西總兵官李謙請偏頭關守備軍如大同例，半歲更番。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Shanxi Regional Commander Li Qian requested Piankou Pass garrison troops follow the Datong precedent of half-year rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Shanxi Commander Li Qian asked Piankou garrison troops to rotate every half year as at Datong.

sentences.zh: 部議，每番皆十月，而戍卒仍率以歲為期，有久而後遣者。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that each shift should be in the tenth month, yet garrison soldiers still generally served by the year, and some were detained long before release.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry ruled each shift should begin in the tenth month, yet men still commonly served a full year and some were held long overdue.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，三邊總制秦紘言：「備御延綏官軍，自十二月赴邊，既週一歲，至次年二月始得代。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi era Three Borders Commander Qin Hong said: "Yansui frontier official troops go to the border from the twelfth month; after a full year they are not replaced until the second month of the next year.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongzhi, Three Borders Commander Qin Hong reported: "Yansui frontier regulars march out in the twelfth month and, after a full year, are not relieved until the second month of the next.

sentences.zh: 在軍日多，請歲一更，上下俱在三月初。」

translations.literal: Days in service are many; request annual rotation with both departure and return in early third month.
translations.idiomatic: They spend too long under arms; he asked for yearly rotation with both departure and return in early third month.

sentences.zh: 邊軍便之。

translations.literal: Frontier troops found this convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier troops welcomed the change.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十三年，巡撫延綏胡志夔請免戍軍三年，每軍徵銀五兩四錢，為募兵用。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Jiajing, Yansui Grand Coordinator Hu Zhikui requested exemption from garrison duty for three years, each soldier paying 5 taels 4 mace of silver for recruiting troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 43, Yansui Grand Coordinator Hu Zhikui asked to exempt garrison troops for three years at 5 taels 4 mace each to fund recruitment.

sentences.zh: 至萬曆初，大同督、撫方逢時等請修築費。

translations.literal: By early Wanli, Datong coordinators Fang Fengshi and others requested repair funds.
translations.idiomatic: By early Wanli, Datong coordinators Fang Fengshi and others sought repair funds.

sentences.zh: 詔以河南應戍班軍，自四年至六年概免，盡扣班價發給，謂之折班，班軍遂耗。

translations.literal: An edict exempted Henan shift troops due for garrison from years four through six, deducting all shift pay for disbursement—called commuted shifts—and shift troops were thus depleted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted Henan shift troops slated for garrison in years 4 through 6, seizing all shift pay for disbursement in what was called commuted shifts, and the shift corps withered.

sentences.zh: 久之，所徵亦不得。

translations.literal: After a long time even what was collected was not obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In time even the commuted payments failed to arrive.

sentences.zh: 寧山、南陽、穎上三衛積逋延綏鎮折班銀至五萬餘兩。

translations.literal: Ningshan, Nanyang, and Yingshang three guards accumulated more than fifty thousand taels in arrears of commuted-shift silver owed to Yansui.
translations.idiomatic: Ningshan, Nanyang, and Yingshang guards alone owed Yansui more than fifty thousand taels in commuted-shift arrears.

sentences.zh: 是後諸邊財力俱盡，敝極矣。

translations.literal: After this the finances of all frontiers were exhausted and utterly worn out.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter every frontier command was financially exhausted.

sentences.zh: 初，邊政嚴明，官軍皆有定職。

translations.literal: Earlier border administration was strict; official troops all had fixed duties.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier frontier administration was strict and every soldier had a fixed duty.

sentences.zh: 總兵官總鎮軍為正兵，副總兵分領三千為奇兵，遊擊分領三千往來防禦為遊兵，參將分守各路東西策應為援兵。

translations.literal: The regional commander commanded the main force; the deputy commander led three thousand as flanking troops; the mobile detachment led three thousand for patrol as roaming troops; the brigade commander held routes for mutual support as relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: The regional commander held the main body; the deputy led three thousand as the flanking force; the mobile detachment led three thousand on patrol; the brigade commander guarded routes for mutual relief.

sentences.zh: 營堡墩臺分極沖、次沖，為設軍多寡。

translations.literal: Camps, forts, and beacon towers were divided into utmost and secondary sectors to set troop numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Camps, forts, and beacons were graded utmost and secondary to fix troop strengths.

sentences.zh: 平時走陣、哨探、守□□、焚荒諸事，無敢惰。

translations.literal: In peacetime drill formations, scouting, beacon watch, and burning off steppe grass—none dared be slack.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime drill, scouting, beacon watch, and steppe-burning allowed no slackness.

sentences.zh: 稍違制，輒按軍法。

translations.literal: Slight violation of regulations was immediately punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: Minor breaches brought immediate military punishment.

sentences.zh: 而其後皆廢壞云。

translations.literal: But afterward all this fell into ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the whole system collapsed.

sentences.zh: 沿海之地，自樂會接安南界，五千里抵閩，又二千里抵浙，又二千里抵南直隸，又千八百里抵山東，又千二百里逾寶坻、盧龍抵遼東，又千三百餘里抵鴨綠江。

translations.literal: Along the coast from Lehui connecting the Annan border for five thousand li reaching Fujian, another two thousand li to Zhejiang, another two thousand li to Nan Zhili, another 1,800 li to Shandong, another 1,200 li crossing Baodi and Lulong to Liaodong, another 1,300-odd li to the Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: The coast ran from Lehui on the Annan frontier five thousand li to Fujian, two thousand more to Zhejiang, two thousand to Nan Zhili, eighteen hundred to Shandong, twelve hundred across Baodi and Lulong to Liaodong, and thirteen hundred more to the Yalu.

sentences.zh: 島寇倭夷，在在出沒，故海防亦重。

translations.literal: Island pirates and Japanese raiders appeared everywhere, so coastal defense was also weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Island pirates and Japanese raiders appeared everywhere, so coastal defense weighed heavily too.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，用浙江行省平章李文忠言，嘉興、海鹽、海寧皆設兵戍守。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wu, on the advice of Zhejiang Branch Secretariat Pacification Commissioner Li Wenzhong, Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Haining all set troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Wu year, on Li Wenzhong's advice, Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Haining all received coastal garrisons.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年十二月，命靖海侯吳禎籍方國珍所部溫、台、慶元三府軍士及蘭秀山無田糧之民，凡十一萬餘人，隸各衛為軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Hongwu, Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen was ordered to register soldiers of Wen, Tai, and Qingyuan three prefectures from Fang Guozhen's former command and Lanshan landless people, more than 110,000 in all, assigning them to guards as troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Hongwu year 4, Marquis of Jinghai Wu Zhen registered more than 110,000 men from Wen, Tai, and Qingyuan—Fang Guozhen's former followers and landless Lanshan people—and enrolled them as guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 且禁沿海民私出海。

translations.literal: Coastal people were also forbidden to go to sea privately.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal inhabitants were forbidden to sail privately.

sentences.zh: 時國珍及張士誠餘眾多竄島嶼間，勾倭為寇。

translations.literal: At that time many of Guozhen's and Zhang Shicheng's remnant followers hid among islands and colluded with Japanese raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Guozhen's and Zhang Shicheng's remnants then hid on islands and colluded with Japanese raiders.

sentences.zh: 五年，命浙江、福建造海舟防倭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zhejiang and Fujian were ordered to build sea vessels against Japanese raids.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Zhejiang and Fujian were ordered to build sea vessels against Japanese raids.

sentences.zh: 明年，從德慶侯廖永忠言，命廣洋、江陰、橫海、水軍四衛增置多櫓快船，無事則巡徼，遇寇以大船薄戰，快船逐之。

translations.literal: The next year, on the advice of Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong, Guangyang, Jiangyin, Henghai, and Shuizhan four guards were ordered to add multi-oared fast boats; in peace they patrolled, and when raiders came the large ships closed to fight while fast boats pursued.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, on Marquis of Deqing Liao Yongzhong's advice, Guangyang, Jiangyin, Henghai, and Shuizhan guards added fast multi-oared boats for patrol in peace and pursuit when large ships engaged raiders.

sentences.zh: 詔禎充總兵官，領四衛兵，京衛及沿海諸衛軍悉聽節制。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Zhen regional commander, commanding the four guards' troops; capital guards and all coastal guards obeyed his direction.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen was appointed regional commander over the four guards, with capital and coastal units under his command.

sentences.zh: 每春以舟師出海，分路防倭，迄秋乃還。

translations.literal: Each spring the fleet went to sea, dividing routes to guard against Japanese raids, returning only in autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Each spring the fleet put to sea on divided routes against Japanese raids and returned in autumn.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命信國公湯和巡視海上，築山東、江南北、浙東西沿海諸城。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Duke of Xin Guo Tang He was ordered to tour the seas and build coastal cities in Shandong, Jiangnan, and north and south Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Duke of Xin Guo Tang He toured the coast and built coastal cities in Shandong, Jiangnan, and both Zhejiangs.

sentences.zh: 後三年，命江夏侯周德興抽福建福、興、漳、泉四府三丁之一，為沿海戍兵，得萬五千人。

translations.literal: Three years later Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing was ordered to draft one man in three from Fu, Xing, Zhang, and Quan four prefectures of Fujian as coastal garrison troops, obtaining 15,000 men.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Marquis of Jiangxia Zhou Dexing drafted one man in three from Fujian's Fu, Xing, Zhang, and Quan prefectures for coastal garrison, yielding 15,000 men.

sentences.zh: 移置衛所於要害處，築城十六。

translations.literal: Guards and posts were moved to vital points and sixteen cities built.
translations.idiomatic: Guard posts were shifted to choke points and sixteen cities built.

sentences.zh: 復置定海、盤石、金鄉、海門四衛於浙，金山衛於松江之小官場，及青村、南匯嘴城二千戶所，又置臨山衛於紹興，及三山、瀝海等千戶所，而寧波、溫、台並海地，先已置八千戶所，曰平陽、三江、龍山、霩戺、大鬆、錢倉、新河、松門，皆屯兵設守。

translations.literal: Dinghai, Panshi, Jinxiang, and Haimen four guards were re-established in Zhejiang; Jinshan Guard at Songjiang's Xiaoguanchang and Qingcun and Nanhuizui two thousand-household posts; Linshan Guard at Shaoxing with Sanshan, Lihai, and other thousand-household posts; and Ningbo, Wen, and Tai coastal areas already had eight thousand-household posts—Pingyang, Sanjiang, Longshan, Huoshi, Dasong, Qiancang, Xinhe, Songmen—all with garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai, Panshi, Jinxiang, and Haimen guards were restored in Zhejiang; Jinshan Guard rose at Songjiang's Xiaoguanchang with Qingcun and Nanhuizui posts; Linshan Guard at Shaoxing with Sanshan and Lihai posts; and Ningbo, Wen, and Tai already held eight coastal thousand-household posts—Pingyang, Sanjiang, Longshan, Huoshi, Dasong, Qiancang, Xinhe, Songmen—all manned.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，又命和行視閩粵，築城增兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year He was again ordered to tour Fujian and Guangdong, building cities and increasing troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 Tang He again toured Fujian and Guangdong to build cities and add troops.

sentences.zh: 置福建沿海指揮使司五，曰福寧、鎮東、平海、永寧、鎮海。

translations.literal: Five Fujian coastal regional-commander offices were established: Funing, Zhendong, Pinghai, Yongning, and Zhenhai.
translations.idiomatic: Five Fujian coastal command offices were established: Funing, Zhendong, Pinghai, Yongning, and Zhenhai.

sentences.zh: 領千戶所十二，曰大金、定海、梅花、萬安、莆禧、崇武、福全、金門、高浦、六鰲、銅山、玄鐘。

translations.literal: They commanded twelve thousand-household posts: Dajin, Dinghai, Meihua, Wan'an, Puxi, Chongwu, Fuquan, Jinmen, Gaopu, Liulao, Tongshan, and Xuanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: They commanded twelve posts: Dajin, Dinghai, Meihua, Wan'an, Puxi, Chongwu, Fuquan, Jinmen, Gaopu, Liulao, Tongshan, and Xuanzhong.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，從衛卒陳仁言，造蘇州太倉衛海舟。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, on guard soldier Chen Ren's advice, sea vessels were built for Suzhou Taicang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, on guard soldier Chen Ren's advice, sea vessels were built for Suzhou Taicang Guard.

sentences.zh: 旋令濱海衛所，每百戶及巡檢司皆置船二，巡海上盜賊。

translations.literal: Coastal guards and posts were soon ordered: every hundred households and inspection office each set up two boats to patrol sea bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal guards and inspection offices were soon ordered to keep two patrol boats per hundred-household unit against sea bandits.

sentences.zh: 後從山東都司周彥言，建五總寨於寧海衛，與萊州衛八總寨，共轄小寨四十八。

translations.literal: Later, on Shandong Regional Command Zhou Yan's advice, five main stockades were built at Ninghai Guard with Laizhou Guard's eight main stockades jointly overseeing forty-eight minor stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on Shandong Regional Command Zhou Yan's advice, five main stockades were built at Ninghai Guard alongside Laizhou's eight, jointly overseeing forty-eight minor stockades.

sentences.zh: 已，覆命重臣勳戚魏國公徐輝祖等分巡沿海。

translations.literal: Soon afterward grand ministers, meritorious nobles, and the Duke of Wei Xu Huizu and others were again ordered to tour the coast in divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ministers and meritorious nobles including Duke of Wei Xu Huizu were soon ordered to tour the coast in divisions.

sentences.zh: 帝素厭日本詭譎，絕其貢使，故終洪武、建文世不為患。

translations.literal: The emperor had long disliked Japanese treachery and cut off their tribute envoys, so through the Hongwu and Jianwen reigns they caused no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had long distrusted Japanese duplicity and cut off tribute envoys, so through Hongwu and Jianwen they caused no major trouble.

sentences.zh: 永樂六年，命豐城侯李彬等緣海捕倭，復招島人、縻戶、賈豎、漁丁為兵，防備益嚴。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongle, Marquis of Fengcheng Li Bin and others were ordered to hunt Japanese raiders along the coast, again recruiting islanders, registered households, merchant sailors, and fishing crews as troops, and coastal defense grew stricter.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 6, Marquis of Fengcheng Li Bin and others hunted Japanese raiders along the coast, recruiting islanders, registered households, merchant sailors, and fishers as troops, tightening coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 十七年，倭寇遼東，總兵官劉江殲之於望海堝。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Japanese raiders attacked Liaodong; Regional Commander Liu Jiang destroyed them at Wanghaipu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Japanese raiders struck Liaodong; Regional Commander Liu Jiang destroyed them at Wanghaipu.

sentences.zh: 自是倭大懼，百餘年間，海上無大侵犯。

translations.literal: From then the Japanese were greatly afraid, and for more than a hundred years there was no major invasion on the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Japan was greatly intimidated, and for more than a century the sea saw no major invasion.

sentences.zh: 朝廷閱數歲一令大臣巡警而已。

translations.literal: The court only ordered grand ministers to patrol every few years.
translations.idiomatic: The court contented itself with ordering grand ministers to patrol every few years.

sentences.zh: 至嘉靖中，倭患漸起，始設巡撫浙江兼管福建海道提督軍務都御史。

translations.literal: By the Jiajing reign Japanese trouble gradually arose, and the post of Grand Coordinator of Zhejiang, also supervising Fujian sea routes as Superintendent of Military Affairs with Vice Censor-in-Chief rank, was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing reign Japanese raids gradually intensified, and the court first established a Grand Coordinator of Zhejiang who also supervised Fujian sea routes as Superintendent of Military Affairs with Vice Censor-in-Chief rank.

sentences.zh: 已，改巡撫為巡視。

translations.literal: Soon after, the title Grand Coordinator was changed to Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the post was retitled from Grand Coordinator to Inspector.

sentences.zh: 未幾，倭寇益肆。

translations.literal: Before long Japanese raiders grew still more rampant.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Japanese raiders grew bolder still.

sentences.zh: 乃增設金山參將，分守蘇、松海防，尋改為副總兵，調募江南、北徐、邳官民兵充戰守，而杭、嘉、湖亦增參將及兵備道。

translations.literal: Then a Regional Vice Commander at Jinshan was added to divide defense of Suzhou-Songjiang coastal defense; soon it was changed to Vice Regional Commander, mobilizing and recruiting Jiangnan, northern Xu, and Pi official and civilian troops to fill combat and garrison duty, while Hang, Jia, and Hu also gained added Regional Vice Commanders and military preparedness commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: A Jinshan regional vice commander was then added for Suzhou-Songjiang coastal defense, soon promoted to vice regional commander, with troops recruited from Jiangnan, northern Xu, and Pi to serve in combat and garrison roles; Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou likewise gained new vice commanders and military preparedness commissioners.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，調撥山東民兵及青州水陸槍手千人赴淮、揚，聽總督南直軍務都御史張經調用。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Shandong civilian militia and one thousand Qingzhou land-and-sea arquebusiers were transferred to Huai and Yang, placed under the orders of Superintendent of Nanzhili Military Affairs Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33, Shandong militia and one thousand Qingzhou land-and-sea arquebusiers were dispatched to Huai and Yangzhou under Nanzhili military superintendent Zhang Jing.

sentences.zh: 時倭縱掠杭、嘉、蘇、松，踞柘林城為窟穴，大江南北皆被擾。

translations.literal: At the time the Japanese raided freely across Hang, Jia, Su, and Song, occupying Zhalin city as a lair, and both north and south of the Long River were disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese raiders were then ravaging Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Suzhou, and Songjiang, holding Zhalin as their base, and both banks of the Yangtze were thrown into disorder.

sentences.zh: 監司任環敗之，經亦有王家涇之捷，乃遁出海，復犯蘇州。

translations.literal: Supervisory official Ren Huan defeated them; Zhang Jing also had victory at Wangjia Creek, whereupon they fled out to sea and again attacked Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory official Ren Huan routed them, and Zhang Jing won at Wangjia Creek as well; the raiders then fled to sea before striking Suzhou again.

sentences.zh: 於是南京御史屠仲律言五事。

translations.literal: Thereupon Nanjing Censor Tu Zhonglü presented five proposals.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing censor Tu Zhonglü then submitted five recommendations.

sentences.zh: 其守海口云：「守平陽港、黃花澳，據海門之險，使不得犯溫、台。

translations.literal: On guarding sea mouths he said: "Guard Pingyang Harbor and Huanghua Bay, hold the peril of Haimen, and keep them from striking Wen and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On coastal defense he said: "Hold Pingyang Harbor and Huanghua Bay and secure Haimen so raiders cannot reach Wenzhou and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 守寧海關、湖頭灣，遏三江之口，使不得窺寧、紹。

translations.literal: Guard Ninghai Pass and Hutou Bay, check the mouth of the Three Rivers, and keep them from spying on Ning and Shao.
translations.idiomatic: Hold Ninghai Pass and Hutou Bay to block the Three Rivers estuary and deny them reconnaissance of Ningbo and Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 守鱉子門、乍浦峽，使不得近杭、嘉。

translations.literal: Guard Biezi Gate and Zhapu Gorge, and keep them from approaching Hang and Jia.
translations.idiomatic: Defend Biezi Gate and Zhapu Strait to keep them from nearing Hangzhou and Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 守吳淞、劉家河、七丫港，使不得掩蘇、松。

translations.literal: Guard Wusong, Liujia River, and Qiya Harbor, and keep them from covering Su and Song by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: Hold Wusong, Liujia River, and Qiya Harbor to forestall surprise attacks on Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 且宜修飭海舟，大小相比，或百或五十聯為一□宗，募慣習水工領之，而充以原額水軍，於諸海口量緩急置防。」

translations.literal: Sea vessels should also be refitted and paired by size, with fleets of fifty or a hundred forming one squadron under experienced watermen, supplemented by the standing naval quota, and defenses staggered at each harbor according to need."
translations.idiomatic: Sea vessels should also be refitted and paired by size, with fleets of fifty or a hundred forming one squadron under experienced watermen, supplemented by the standing naval quota, and defenses staggered at each harbor according to need."

sentences.zh: 部是其議。

translations.literal: The ministry approved his plan.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved his proposals.

sentences.zh: 未幾，兵部亦言：「浙、直、通、泰間最利水戰，往時多用沙船破賊，請厚賞招徠之。

translations.literal: Before long the Ministry of War also said: "Between Zhe, Nanzhili, Tong, and Tai water combat is most advantageous; formerly sand junks were often used to defeat bandits—please richly reward and recruit them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Ministry of War added: "The waters between Zhejiang, Nanzhili, Tongzhou, and Taizhou favor naval combat; sand junks once broke the enemy—generous rewards should recruit them.

sentences.zh: 防禦之法，守海島為上，宜以太倉、崇明、嘉定、上海沙船及福倉、東莞等船守普陀、大衢。

translations.literal: In methods of defense, holding sea islands is best; Taicang, Chongming, Jiading, and Shanghai sand junks and Fukang, Dongguan, and similar vessels should guard Putuo and Daqu.
translations.idiomatic: The best defense is to hold the offshore islands, using sand junks from Taicang, Chongming, Jiading, and Shanghai and vessels from Fukang and Dongguan to guard Putuo and Daqu.

sentences.zh: 陳錢山乃浙、直分路之始，狼、福二山約束首尾，交接江洋，亦要害地，宜督水師固守。」

translations.literal: Chenqian Mountain is where Zhe and Nanzhili routes divide; Lang and Fu two mountains constrain head and tail where river and sea meet—it too is a strategic place and water forces should be ordered to hold it firmly."
translations.idiomatic: Chenqian Mountain marks where Zhejiang and Nanzhili routes divide; Lang and Fu Mountains bracket the junction of river and sea—a vital point the fleet should hold fast."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Reply: approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 已，復令直隸吳淞江、劉家河、福山港、鎮江、圌山五總添設遊兵，聽金山副總兵調度。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the five commands of Nanzhili—Wusong River, Liujia River, Fushan Harbor, Zhenjiang, and Mount Tu—were again ordered to add roaming troops, subject to the Jinshan Vice Regional Commander's dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhili's five commands—Wusong River, Liujia River, Fushan Harbor, Zhenjiang, and Mount Tu—were then ordered to add mobile detachments under the Jinshan vice regional commander.

sentences.zh: 時胡宗憲為總督，誅海賊徐海、汪直。

translations.literal: At the time Hu Zongxian was Superintendent; he executed sea bandits Xu Hai and Wang Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zongxian then served as superintendent and executed the pirates Xu Hai and Wang Zhi.

sentences.zh: 直部三千人，復勾倭入寇，閩、廣益騷。

translations.literal: Wang Zhi's three thousand men again colluded with Japanese to invade, and Fujian and Guangdong grew more disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi's three thousand followers again allied with Japanese raiders, throwing Fujian and Guangdong into greater turmoil.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，都御史王詢請「分福建之福、興為一路，領以參將，駐福寧，水防自流江、烽火門、俞山、小埕至南日山，漳、泉為一路，領以參將，駐詔安，水防自南日山至浯嶼、銅山、玄鐘、走馬溪、安邊館。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Xun petitioned: "Divide Fujian's Fu and Xing into one route, led by a Regional Vice Commander stationed at Funing, with water defense from Liujiang, Fenghuo Gate, Yushan, and Xiaocheng to Nanri Mountain; Zhang and Quan as one route, led by a Regional Vice Commander stationed at Zhao'an, with water defense from Nanri Mountain to Wuyu, Tongshan, Xuanzhong, Zouma Creek, and Anbian Station.
translations.idiomatic: In year 37 vice censor-in-chief Wang Xun proposed splitting Fujian: Fu and Xing as one zone under a regional vice commander at Funing, guarding from Liujiang, Fenghuo Gate, Yushan, and Xiaocheng to Nanri Mountain; Zhangzhou and Quanzhou as another under a vice commander at Zhao'an, guarding from Nanri to Wuyu, Tongshan, Xuanzhong, Zouma Creek, and Anbian Station.

sentences.zh: 水陸兵皆聽節制。

translations.literal: Land and sea forces alike obeyed his command.
translations.idiomatic: All land and sea forces were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 福建省城介在南北，去海僅五十里，宜更設參將，選募精稅部領哨船，與主客兵相應援」。

translations.literal: Fujian's provincial seat lies between north and south, only fifty li from the sea; another Regional Vice Commander should be set up, selecting and recruiting elite troops to lead patrol boats, coordinating with regular and auxiliary forces."
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's capital lies midway between the two zones, only fifty li from the sea; another regional vice commander should be appointed with elite troops to command patrol boats in support of regular and auxiliary forces."

sentences.zh: 部覆從之。

translations.literal: The ministry reviewed and followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 廣東惠、潮亦增設參將，駐揭陽。

translations.literal: Guangdong's Huizhou and Chaozhou also gained an added Regional Vice Commander stationed at Jieyang.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's Huizhou and Chaozhou likewise gained a regional vice commander at Jieyang.

sentences.zh: 福建巡撫都御史遊震得言：「浙江溫、處與福寧接壤，倭所出沒，宜進戚繼光為副總兵，守之。

translations.literal: Fujian Grand Coordinator Vice Censor-in-Chief You Zhende said: "Zhejiang's Wen and Chu border Funing where Japanese appear and vanish; Qi Jiguang should be advanced to Vice Regional Commander to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian grand coordinator You Zhende urged: "As Wenzhou and Chuzhou in Zhejiang adjoin Funing, the raiders' main haunt, Qi Jiguang should be promoted to vice regional commander to defend the sector.

sentences.zh: 而增設福寧守備，隸繼光。

translations.literal: An added Funing garrison commander should be set up, subordinate to Jiguang.
translations.idiomatic: A new Funing garrison commander should be added under Jiguang's command.

sentences.zh: 漳州之月港亦增設守備，隸總兵官俞大猷。

translations.literal: Zhangzhou's Yue Harbor should also gain an added garrison commander, subordinate to Regional Commander Yu Dayou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzhou's Yue Harbor should likewise gain a garrison commander under regional commander Yu Dayou.

sentences.zh: 延、建、邵為八閩上游，宜募兵以備緩急。」

translations.literal: Yan, Jian, and Shao are the upper reaches of the Eight Min; troops should be recruited against emergencies."
translations.idiomatic: Yanping, Jianning, and Shaowu form Fujian's interior uplands; troops should be recruited for emergencies."

sentences.zh: 皆允行。

translations.literal: All were approved and carried out.
