translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 既而宗憲被逮，罷總督官，以浙江巡撫趙炳然兼任軍事。

translations.literal: Before long Zongxian was arrested, the superintendent post abolished, and Zhejiang Grand Coordinator Zhao Bingran made to oversee military affairs concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxian was soon arrested, the superintendent's office abolished, and Zhejiang grand coordinator Zhao Bingran placed in charge of military affairs as well.

sentences.zh: 炳然因請令定海總兵屬浙江，金山總兵屬南直，俱兼理水陸軍務，互相策應。

translations.literal: Bingran accordingly requested that Dinghai Regional Commander belong to Zhejiang and Jinshan Regional Commander to Nanzhili, both overseeing land and sea military affairs together and supporting each other.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bingran asked that the Dinghai regional commander answer to Zhejiang and the Jinshan commander to Nanzhili, each handling both land and sea forces in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 其後，莆田倭寇平，乃復五水寨舊制。

translations.literal: Afterward, when Putian Japanese raiders were pacified, the old system of five water stockades was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After Putian was pacified, the five water stockades were restored to their former system.

sentences.zh: 五寨者，福寧之烽火門，福州之小埕澳，興化之南日山，泉州之浯嶼，漳州之西門澳，亦曰銅山。

translations.literal: The five stockades were Funing's Fenghuo Gate, Fuzhou's Xiaocheng Bay, Xinghua's Nanri Mountain, Quanzhou's Wuyu, and Zhangzhou's Ximen Bay—also called Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: The five stockades were Fenghuo Gate in Funing, Xiaocheng Bay in Fuzhou, Nanri Mountain in Xinghua, Wuyu in Quanzhou, and Ximen Bay in Zhangzhou—also known as Tongshan.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，鎮守尚書薛希璉奏建者也，後廢。

translations.literal: They were memorialized and built in the third year of Jingtai by garrison minister Xue Xilian, and later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison minister Xue Xilian had petitioned for their establishment in Jingtai year 3; they were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 至是巡撫譚綸疏言：「五寨守扼外洋，法甚周悉，宜復舊。

translations.literal: At this point Grand Coordinator Tan Lun memorialized: "The five stockades guard and choke the outer sea; the method is very thorough and the old system should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator Tan Lun then argued: "The five stockades block the open sea and form a thorough system—they should be restored.

sentences.zh: 以烽火門、南日、浯嶼三□宗為正兵，銅山、小埕二 □宗為遊兵。

translations.literal: Fenghuo Gate, Nanri, and Wuyu would hold three regular squadrons; Tongshan and Xiaocheng would hold two mobile squadrons.
translations.idiomatic: Fenghuo Gate, Nanri, and Wuyu would hold three regular squadrons; Tongshan and Xiaocheng would hold two mobile squadrons.

sentences.zh: 寨設把總，分汛地，明斥堠，嚴會哨。

translations.literal: Each stockade set a platoon commander, divided patrol sectors, clarified watch-beacons, and tightened joint sentry.
translations.idiomatic: Each stockade would have a platoon commander, divided patrol sectors, cleared beacon lines, and strict joint sentry duty.

sentences.zh: 改三路參將為守備。

translations.literal: The three-route Regional Vice Commanders were changed to garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The three regional vice commanders became garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 分新募浙兵為二班，各九千人，春秋番上。

translations.literal: Newly recruited Zhe troops were divided into two shifts of nine thousand each, rotating seasonally in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: New Zhejiang recruits were split into two nine-thousand-man shifts on spring-autumn rotation.

sentences.zh: 各縣民壯皆補用精悍，每府領以武職一人，兵備使者以時閱視。」

translations.literal: Each county's civilian militia were all supplemented with stalwarts; each prefecture was led by one military officer, and the military preparedness commissioner inspected them periodically."
translations.idiomatic: County militia were filled out with the ablest men, each prefecture overseen by a military officer and inspected periodically by the military preparedness commissioner."

sentences.zh: 帝皆是之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved it all.

sentences.zh: 狼山故設副總兵，至是改為鎮守總兵官，兼轄大江南北。

translations.literal: Langshan formerly had a Vice Regional Commander; by now it was changed to Garrison Regional Commander, overseeing both north and south of the Long River jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Langshan, which had held a vice regional commander, was now elevated to garrison regional commander with authority over both sides of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 迨隆慶初，倭漸不為患，而諸小寇往往有之。

translations.literal: By the opening of Longqing the Japanese gradually ceased to be a scourge, yet various minor bandits still appeared from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: By early Longqing the Japanese threat had waned, though petty raiders still appeared intermittently.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三年，設廣東南澳總兵官，以其據漳、泉要害也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli a Guangdong Nan'ao Regional Commander was established, because it commands the strategic choke of Zhang and Quan.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 3 a Guangdong Nan'ao regional commander was installed to hold the strategic junction of Zhangzhou and Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，倭寇朝鮮，朝廷大發兵往援，先後六年。

translations.literal: After a long time Japanese raiders attacked Korea; the court sent great armies to aid it, altogether six years in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese forces later invaded Korea, and the court mounted major relief expeditions over six years.

sentences.zh: 於是設巡撫官於天津，防畿甸。

translations.literal: Thereupon a grand coordinator was placed at Tianjin to guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: A grand coordinator was then stationed at Tianjin to guard the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 後十餘年，從南直巡按御史顏思忠言，分淮安大營兵六百守廖角嘴。

translations.literal: More than ten years later, on Nanzhili touring investigating censor Yan Sizhong's advice, six hundred men from Huai'an's main camp were divided to guard Liaojiaozui.
translations.idiomatic: A decade later, on Nanzhili investigating censor Yan Sizhong's recommendation, six hundred troops from Huai'an's main camp were posted at Liaojiaozui.

sentences.zh: 從福建巡撫丁繼嗣言，設兵自浙入閩之三江及劉澳，而易海澄團練營土著軍以浙兵。

translations.literal: On Fujian Grand Coordinator Ding Jisi's advice, troops were set from Zhe entering Fujian at the Three Rivers and Liu'ao, and native forces of Haicheng drill camp were replaced with Zhe troops.
translations.idiomatic: On Fujian grand coordinator Ding Jisi's advice, troops entering Fujian from Zhejiang were posted at the Three Rivers and Liu'ao, and Haicheng's local drill corps were replaced with Zhejiang troops.

sentences.zh: 天啟中，築城於澎湖，設遊擊一，把總二，統兵三千，築砲臺以守。

translations.literal: In the Tianqi reign a city was built at Penghu; one roaming commander and two platoon commanders were set, commanding three thousand troops, with cannon platforms built for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tianqi, Penghu was fortified with a walled garrison: one mobile commander, two platoon commanders, and three thousand troops manning gun platforms.

sentences.zh: 先是，萬曆中，許孚遠撫閩，奏築福州海壇山，因及澎湖諸嶼，且言浙東沿海陳錢、金塘、玉環、南麂諸山俱宜經理，遂設南麂副總兵，而澎湖不暇及。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Wanli reign, Xu Fuyuan governed Fujian and memorialized to build Fuzhou's Haitan Mountain, extending to the Penghu islands, and also said that along eastern Zhe's coast Chenqian, Jintang, Yuhuan, Nanji, and other mountains all should be administered; thus a Nanji Vice Regional Commander was set up, but Penghu had no time to be attended to.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier under Wanli, Fujian governor Xu Fuyuan petitioned to fortify Fuzhou's Haitan Mountain and extend control to the Penghu islands, urging that Chenqian, Jintang, Yuhuan, Nanji, and other Zhejiang coastal points also be garrisoned; a Nanji vice regional commander was appointed, but Penghu was left unattended.

sentences.zh: 其地遙峙海中，逶迤如修蛇，多岐港零嶼，其中空間可藏巨艘。

translations.literal: The place stands far out in the sea, winding like a long snake, with many branching harbors and scattered islets; within them open spaces can hide great vessels.
translations.idiomatic: The islands stand far offshore, winding like a serpent, with branching harbors and scattered islets whose inner waters can shelter large ships.

sentences.zh: 初為紅毛所據，至是因巡撫南居益言，乃奪而守之。

translations.literal: At first it was held by the Red-Hairs; at this point, on Grand Coordinator Nan Juyi's advice, it was seized back and garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Dutch had first occupied it; on grand coordinator Nan Juyi's recommendation the Ming seized and garrisoned it.

sentences.zh: 自世宗世倭患以來，沿海大都會，各設總督、巡撫、兵備副使及總兵官、參將、遊擊等員，而諸所防禦，於廣東則分東、中、西三路，設三參將；

translations.literal: Since the Japanese scourge in the Shizong reign, each major coastal metropolis has had superintendents, grand coordinators, military preparedness vice commissioners, regional commanders, regional vice commanders, roaming commanders, and the like; among the defenses, in Guangdong the east, center, and west three routes were divided with three regional vice commanders set;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Jiajing-era wokou crisis, every major coastal city has gained superintendents, grand coordinators, military preparedness commissioners, regional commanders, vice commanders, and mobile commanders; in Guangdong the coast was split into eastern, central, and western routes with three vice commanders;

sentences.zh: 於福建則有五水寨；

translations.literal: in Fujian there were the five water stockades;
translations.idiomatic: in Fujian there were the five water stockades;

sentences.zh: 於浙則有六總，一金鄉、盤石二衛，一松門、海門二衛，一昌國衛及錢倉、爵溪等所，一定海衛及霩戺、大嵩等所，一觀海、臨山二衛，一海寧衛，分統以四參將；

translations.literal: in Zhe there were six commands—one of Jinxian and Panshi two guards, one of Songmen and Haimen two guards, one of Changguo Guard with Qiancang, Juexi, and other posts, one of Dinghai Guard with Huoshi, Dasong, and other posts, one of Guanhai and Linshan two guards, one of Haining Guard—divided and commanded by four regional vice commanders;
translations.idiomatic: in Zhejiang there were six commands covering Jinxian and Panshi, Songmen and Haimen, Changguo with Qiancang and Juexi, Dinghai with Huoshi and Dasong, Guanhai and Linshan, and Haining, under four vice commanders;

sentences.zh: 於南直隸則乍浦以東，金山衛設參將，黃浦以北，吳淞江口設總兵；

translations.literal: in Nanzhili, east of Zhapu a regional vice commander was set at Jinshan Guard, and north of Huangpu a regional commander at Wusong River mouth;
translations.idiomatic: in Nanzhili a vice commander at Jinshan Guard held east of Zhapu, and a regional commander at the Wusong estuary held north of Huangpu;

sentences.zh: 於淮、揚則總兵駐通州，遊擊駐廟灣，又於揚州設陸兵遊擊，待調遣；

translations.literal: in Huai and Yang the regional commander was stationed at Tongzhou, the roaming commander at Miaowan, and at Yangzhou a land-force roaming commander was also set, awaiting dispatch;
translations.idiomatic: in Huai and Yangzhou the regional commander was at Tongzhou, a mobile commander at Miaowan, and a land mobile commander at Yangzhou for dispatch as needed;

sentences.zh: 於山東則登、萊、青三府設巡察海道之副使，管理民兵之參將，總督沿海兵馬備倭之都指揮，於薊、遼則大沽海口宿重兵，領以副總兵，而以密雲、永平兩遊擊為應援。

translations.literal: in Shandong the three prefectures Deng, Lai, and Qing had vice commissioners touring sea routes, regional vice commanders managing civilian militia, and regional commanders-in-chief supervising coastal troops against Japanese raiders; in Ji and Liao heavy troops were quartered at Dagu sea mouth, led by a vice regional commander, with Miyun and Yongping two roaming commanders as support.
translations.idiomatic: in Shandong Deng, Lai, and Qing had sea-route vice commissioners, militia vice commanders, and coastal anti-raider commanders-in-chief; in Ji and Liaodong heavy forces at Dagu were led by a vice regional commander with Miyun and Yongping mobile commanders in support.

sentences.zh: 山海關外，則廣寧中、前等五所兵守各汛，以寧前參將為應援，而金、復、海、蓋諸軍皆任防海。

translations.literal: Outside Shanhai Pass, troops of Guangning Center, Front, and the other five posts guarded each sector, with the Ningqian regional vice commander as support, while Jin, Fu, Hai, and Gai forces all bore coastal defense duty.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Shanhai Pass, the five Guangning garrison posts held their sectors with the Ningqian vice commander in support, while Jinzhou, Fuxian, Haizhou, and Gaizhou troops all shared coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 三岔以東，九聯城外創鎮江城，設遊擊，統兵千七百，哨海上，北與寬奠參將陸營相接，共計凡七鎮，而守備、把總、分守、巡徼會哨者不下數百員。

translations.literal: East of Sancha, outside Jiulian city Zhenjiang city was newly built; a roaming commander was set commanding one thousand seven hundred troops to patrol the sea, linking north with Kuandian regional vice commander's land camp—in all seven garrisons, while garrison commanders, platoon commanders, divided defense officers, and patrol and joint-sentry officers numbered no fewer than several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: East of Sancha a new Zhenjiang walled post outside Jiulian held a mobile commander with seventeen hundred men patrolling the sea, linking north to Kuandian's land forces—seven garrisons in all, with hundreds of garrison, platoon, patrol, and sentry officers.

sentences.zh: 以三、四、五月為大汛，九、十月為小汛。

translations.literal: The third, fourth, and fifth months were the great flood season, the ninth and tenth the lesser.
translations.idiomatic: March through May marked the main alert season, September and October the secondary.

sentences.zh: 蓋遭倭甚毒，故設防亦最密云。

translations.literal: Because the suffering from Japanese raiders was very severe, defenses were also set up most densely.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese raids had been so devastating that coastal defenses were laid out with exceptional density.

sentences.zh: 日本地與閩相值，而浙之招寶關其貢道在焉，故浙、閩為最沖。

translations.literal: Japan's territory faces Fujian, while Zhe's Zhaobao Pass lies on its tribute route; therefore Zhe and Fujian are the most exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Japan lies opposite Fujian, and Zhejiang's Zhaobao Pass sits on the tribute route, making Zhejiang and Fujian the most vulnerable coasts.

sentences.zh: 南寇則廣東，北寇則由江犯留都、淮、揚，故防海外，防江為重。

translations.literal: Southern raiders struck Guangdong; northern raiders came by the river against the secondary capital, Huai, and Yang—therefore defense of the outer sea and defense of the river were both weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Southern raiders hit Guangdong; northern ones came up the Yangtze against Nanjing, Huai, and Yangzhou—so both seaward and river defense mattered greatly.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，於都城南新江口置水兵八千。

translations.literal: In early Hongwu, eight thousand naval troops were placed at the capital's southern Xinjing River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In early Hongwu eight thousand naval troops were posted at Xinjingkou south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 已，稍置萬二千，造舟四百艘。

translations.literal: Soon after, twelve thousand more were gradually added and four hundred boats built.
translations.idiomatic: The force was soon raised to twelve thousand and four hundred vessels built.

sentences.zh: 又設陸兵於北岸浦子口，相掎角。

translations.literal: Land forces were also set on the north bank at Puzikou, mutually bracing each other.
translations.idiomatic: Land forces were also posted on the north bank at Puzikou in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 所轄沿江諸郡。

translations.literal: They governed the various prefectures along the river.
translations.idiomatic: They had jurisdiction over the prefectures along the river.

sentences.zh: 上自九江、廣濟、黃梅，下抵蘇、松、通、泰，中包安慶、池、和、太平，凡盜賊及販私鹽者，悉令巡捕，兼以防倭。

translations.literal: From Jiujiang, Guangji, and Huangmei above down to Su, Song, Tong, and Tai below, including Anqing, Chi, He, and Taiping in the middle—all bandits and private-salt traffickers were ordered patrolled and captured, also guarding against Japanese raiders.
translations.idiomatic: From Jiujiang, Guangji, and Huangmei upstream to Suzhou, Songjiang, Tongzhou, and Taizhou downstream, including Anqing, Chizhou, Hezhou, and Taiping in between—all bandits and salt smugglers were to be hunted down, with anti-raider duty as well.

sentences.zh: 永樂時，特命勳臣為帥視江操，其後兼用都御史。

translations.literal: In the Yongle reign meritorious nobles were specially appointed commanders to oversee Yangtze maneuvers; afterward vice censors-in-chief were also used jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongle meritorious nobles were appointed to command Yangtze drills; later vice censors-in-chief shared the role.

sentences.zh: 成化四年，從錦衣衛僉事馮瑤言，令江兵依地設防，於瓜、儀、太平置將領鎮守。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chenghua, on Embroidered-Uniform Guard Assistant Commissioner Feng Yao's advice, river troops were ordered to set defenses by locality, with generals placed to garrison at Gua, Yi, and Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 4, on Embroidered Uniform Guard assistant commissioner Feng Yao's advice, river forces were deployed by sector with garrison generals at Gua, Yi, and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 後六年，守備定西侯蔣琬奏調建陽、鎮江諸衛軍補江兵缺伍。

translations.literal: Six years later, garrison commander Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan memorialized to transfer troops of Jianyang, Zhenjiang, and other guards to fill gaps in river forces.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later garrison commander Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan petitioned to transfer Jianyang, Zhenjiang, and other guard troops to fill river-force vacancies.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命擇武大臣一人職江操，毋攝營務。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year one military grand minister was ordered chosen to hold Yangtze maneuvers, without taking on camp duties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 one senior military official was chosen to command Yangtze drills exclusively, without other camp duties.

sentences.zh: 又五年，從南京都御史白昂言，敕沿江守備官互相應援，並給關防。

translations.literal: Five years later still, on Nanjing Vice Censor-in-Chief Bai Ang's advice, river-bank garrison commanders were ordered to support each other and given official seals.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later, on Nanjing vice censor-in-chief Bai Ang's advice, riverside garrison commanders were ordered to support one another and issued official seals.

sentences.zh: 著為令。

translations.literal: This was written as a standing order.
translations.idiomatic: This was codified as a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，命新江口兩班軍如京營例，首班歇，即以次班操。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi reign the two shifts at Xinjingkou were ordered like the capital garrison: when the first shift rested, the second shift drilled at once.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongzhi Xinjingkou's two shifts followed capital-garrison practice: when one rested, the other drilled.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年，江陰賊侯仲金等作亂，給事中夏言請設鎮守江、淮總兵官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiajing bandits at Jiangyin such as Hou Zhongjin rebelled; Supervising Secretary Xia Yan requested a Garrison Regional Commander of the Yangtze and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 8 Jiangyin rebels led by Hou Zhongjin rose up; supervising secretary Xia Yan petitioned for a garrison regional commander over the Yangtze and Huai.

sentences.zh: 已而寇平，總兵罷不設。

translations.literal: Soon the bandits were pacified and the regional commander post abolished and not re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Once the rebels were suppressed, the regional commander post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十九年，沙賊黃艮等復起。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year sand-bandits Huang Gen and others rose again.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 sand pirates led by Huang Gen rose again.

sentences.zh: 帝詰兵部以罷總兵之故，乃復設，給旗牌符敕，提督沿江上下。

translations.literal: The emperor questioned the Ministry of War on the reason for abolishing the regional commander, then re-established the post, gave banners, placards, and sealed commissions, and made him superintendent over the river above and below.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked the Ministry of War for abolishing the post, reinstated it with banners and sealed commissions, and charged him to supervise the entire Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 後復裁罷。

translations.literal: Later it was again cut and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was later abolished again.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，倭患熾，復設副總兵於金山衛，轄沿海至鎮江，與狼山副總兵水陸相應。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, as the Japanese scourge blazed, a Vice Regional Commander was again set at Jinshan Guard, governing the coast to Zhenjiang, coordinating land and sea with Langshan's Vice Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In year 32, as the wokou crisis intensified, a vice regional commander was restored at Jinshan Guard, holding the coast to Zhenjiang in land-sea coordination with Langshan.

sentences.zh: 時江北俱被倭，於是量調九江、安慶官軍守京口、圌山等地。

translations.literal: At the time all north of the river was ravaged by Japanese raiders; accordingly official troops of Jiujiang and Anqing were proportionally transferred to guard Jingkou, Mount Tu, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: With the north bank overrun, official troops from Jiujiang and Anqing were dispatched to hold Jingkou, Mount Tu, and related posts.

sentences.zh: 久之，給事中範宗吳言：「故事，操江都御史防江，應、鳳二巡撫防海。

translations.literal: After a long time Supervising Secretary Fan Zongwu said: "By precedent the Yangtze-command Vice Censor-in-Chief defended the river, while the Ying and Feng two grand coordinators defended the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Later supervising secretary Fan Zongwu argued: "By precedent the Yangtze-command vice censor defended the river while the Yingzhou and Fengyang grand coordinators defended the sea.

sentences.zh: 後因倭警，遂以鎮江而下，通常、狼、福諸處隸之操江，以故二撫臣得諉其責。

translations.literal: Later, because of Japanese alarms, from Zhenjiang downward Tong, Chang, Lang, Fu, and other places were placed under Yangtze command, so the two grand coordinators could shift their responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: After the wokou alert, posts from Zhenjiang down through Tongzhou, Changzhou, Langshan, and Fushan were assigned to Yangtze command, letting the two grand coordinators evade their duties.

sentences.zh: 操江又以向非本屬兵，難遙制，亦漠然視之，非委任責成意。

translations.literal: Yangtze command also, because the troops had not formerly been its own, found remote control difficult and likewise viewed them indifferently—not the intent of entrusting responsibility and demanding results.
translations.idiomatic: Yangtze command, finding these were not its original troops and hard to control at a distance, treated them indifferently as well—not true delegation of responsibility.

sentences.zh: 宜以圌山、三江會口為操、撫分界。」

translations.literal: Mount Tu and the Three Rivers junction should serve as the boundary between Yangtze command and the grand coordinators."
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tu and the Three Rivers junction should mark the boundary between Yangtze command and the coastal grand coordinators."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Reply: approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 其後增上下兩江巡視御史，得舉劾有司將領，而以南京歛都御史兼理操江，不另設。

translations.literal: Afterward upper and lower Yangtze inspecting censors were added, empowered to impeach civil and military officials, while the Nanjing supervising vice censor-in-chief also handled Yangtze command concurrently, without a separate appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and lower Yangtze inspecting censors were then added with power to impeach officials, while Nanjing's supervising vice censor-in-chief took Yangtze command as well, without a separate post.

sentences.zh: 先是，增募水兵六千。

translations.literal: Earlier, six thousand naval troops had been added by recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand additional naval troops had earlier been recruited.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，以都御史吳時來請，留四之一，餘悉罷遣，並裁中軍把總等官。

translations.literal: At the opening of Longqing, on Vice Censor-in-Chief Wu Shilai's request, one quarter was kept and the rest all dismissed, and central-army platoon commanders and similar posts were also cut.
translations.idiomatic: In early Longqing, on vice censor-in-chief Wu Shilai's petition, only a quarter were retained and the rest discharged, with central-army platoon commanders also abolished.

sentences.zh: 已，復令分汛設守，而責以上下南北互相策應。

translations.literal: Soon after, divided flood-season garrisons were again ordered set up, with responsibility that upper, lower, south, and north support each other.
translations.idiomatic: Sector garrisons were soon restored with orders that upper, lower, and north-south forces support one another.

sentences.zh: 又從都御史宋儀望言，諸軍皆分駐江上，不得居城市。

translations.literal: Again, on Vice Censor-in-Chief Song Yiwang's advice, all troops were divided to garrison along the river and might not dwell in cities.
translations.idiomatic: On vice censor-in-chief Song Yiwang's advice, all troops were posted along the river and forbidden to live in cities.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十年，以倭警，言者請復設京口總兵。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Wanli, because of Japanese alarms, memorialists requested re-establishing the Jingkou regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 20, amid Japanese alarms, officials asked to restore the Jingkou regional commander.

sentences.zh: 南京兵部尚書衷貞吉等謂既有吳淞總兵，不宜兩設。

translations.literal: Nanjing Minister of War Yuan Zhenji and others said that since there was already a Wusong regional commander, two should not be established.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing War Minister Yuan Zhenji and others argued that with a Wusong commander already in place, a second post was unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 乃設兵備使者，每春汛，調備倭都督，統衛所水、陸軍赴鎮江。

translations.literal: Thereupon a military preparedness commissioner was established; each spring flood season the anti-Japanese regional commander was mobilized to lead guard water and land forces to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Instead a military preparedness commissioner was appointed; each spring flood season the anti-Japanese commander led guard water and land forces to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 後七年，操江耿定力奏：「長江千餘里，上江列營五，兵備臣三；

translations.literal: Seven years later Yangtze commander Geng Dingli memorialized: "The Yangtze stretches more than a thousand li; the upper river has five camps and three military preparedness officials;
translations.idiomatic: Seven years later Yangtze commander Geng Dingli reported: "The Yangtze runs more than a thousand li; the upper river holds five camps and three preparedness commissioners;

sentences.zh: 下江列營五，兵備臣二。

translations.literal: the lower river has five camps and two military preparedness officials.
translations.idiomatic: the lower river has five camps and two preparedness commissioners.

sentences.zh: 宜委以簡閱訓練，即以精否為兵備殿最。」

translations.literal: They should be entrusted with review inspection and training, and preparedness officials' performance rankings should be based on troop quality."
translations.idiomatic: They should be charged with muster and drill, and preparedness commissioners ranked by how sharp their troops proved."

sentences.zh: 部議以為然。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry endorsed the proposal.

sentences.zh: 故事，南北總哨官五日一會哨於適中地，將領官亦月兩至江上會哨。

translations.literal: By precedent, north and south chief sentry officers met for joint sentry every five days at a midway place; commanding generals also came to the river twice monthly for joint sentry.
translations.idiomatic: By regulation north and south chief sentries convened every five days at a midway post, and field commanders twice monthly on the river for joint inspection.

sentences.zh: 其後多不行。

translations.literal: Afterward most did not implement it.
translations.idiomatic: In time the practice largely fell into disuse.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，復以勳臣任操江，偷惰成習，會哨巡徼皆虛名，非有實矣。

translations.literal: In the Chongzhen reign, again merit nobles held Yangtze command; indolence became custom; joint sentry and river patrol were all empty names, without reality.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chongzhen nobles again held Yangtze command, slackness hardened into habit, and joint sentry and patrol became hollow formalities altogether.

sentences.zh: 衛所之外，郡縣有民壯，邊郡有土兵。

translations.literal: Beyond guard units, prefectures and counties had civilian strongmen; frontier prefectures had local troops.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the guard system prefectures kept civilian militia, and frontier districts local levies.

sentences.zh: 太祖定江東，循元制，立管領民兵萬戶府。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor pacified Jiangdong, followed Yuan institutions, and established offices of ten-thousand-households administering militia.
translations.idiomatic: When the dynasty secured Jiangdong it retained the Yuan militia ten-thousand-household offices.

sentences.zh: 後從山西行都司言，聽邊民自備軍械，團結防邊。

translations.literal: Later, following the Shanxi regional commissioner's proposal, frontier people were permitted to provide their own arms and band together to defend the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the Shanxi commander's advice border communities were later allowed to arm themselves and organize for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 閩、浙苦倭，指揮方謙請籍民丁多者為軍。

translations.literal: Fujian and Zhejiang suffered from pirates; Commander Fang Qian requested registering households with many adult males as troops.
translations.idiomatic: With Fujian and Zhejiang ravaged by pirates, Commander Fang Qian asked to draft households with many adult sons.

sentences.zh: 尋以為患鄉里，詔閩、浙互徙。

translations.literal: Soon because it harmed local communities, an edict ordered Fujian and Zhejiang mutual relocation.
translations.idiomatic: They soon proved a nuisance to home districts, and an edict ordered mutual transfers between Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時已用民兵，然非召募也。

translations.literal: At the time militia were already used, but not by recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Militia were already in use by then, though not yet on a recruitment basis.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，始募所在軍餘、民壯願自效者，陝西得四千二百人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, recruitment began of remaining troops and willing civilian strongmen wherever found; Shaanxi obtained four thousand two hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 2 the state first recruited surplus garrison men and willing militiamen; Shaanxi mustered 4,200.

sentences.zh: 人給布二匹，月糧四斗。

translations.literal: Each man was given two bolts of cloth and four dou monthly grain.
translations.idiomatic: Each recruit received two bolts of cloth and four dou of grain per month.

sentences.zh: 景泰初，遣使分募直隸、山東、山西、河南民壯，撥山西義勇守大同，而紫荊、倒馬二關，亦用民兵防守，事平免歸。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingtai, envoys were sent to recruit civilian strongmen separately in Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan; Shanxi volunteers were assigned to guard Datong, and Zijing and Daoma passes also used militia for defense; when affairs settled they were released home.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jingtai envoys recruited militia across Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan; Shanxi volunteers garrisoned Datong, and Zijing and Daoma passes were also held by militia until the crisis passed and they were discharged.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，以邊警，復二關民兵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua, because of frontier alarms, the two passes' militia were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua year 2 saw border alarms and the restoration of militia at the two passes.

sentences.zh: 敕御史往延安、慶陽選精壯編伍，得五千餘人，號曰土兵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered censors to Yan'an and Qingyang to select stalwart men and form companies, obtaining more than five thousand, styled local troops.
translations.idiomatic: Censors were dispatched to Yan'an and Qingyang to choose sturdy men and form units of more than 5,000, called local troops.

sentences.zh: 以延綏巡撫盧祥言邊民驍果，可練為兵，使護田裡妻子，故有是命。

translations.literal: Because Yan-sui grand coordinator Lu Xiang said frontier people were fierce and capable, could be drilled as troops, and made to protect fields, villages, and families, therefore this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Yan-sui governor Lu Xiang had argued that frontier villagers were rugged and trainable as soldiers to guard their fields and families, which prompted the order.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年，立歛民壯法。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongzhi, the law for levying civilian strongmen was established.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi year 7 saw regulations for drafting civilian militia.

sentences.zh: 州、縣七八百里以上，裡歛二人，五百里三，三百里四，百里以上五。

translations.literal: For prefectures and counties of seven or eight hundred li and above, two men per li were levied; at five hundred li, three; at three hundred li, four; at one hundred li and above, five.
translations.idiomatic: Districts of 700-800 li or more drafted two men per li; those of 500 li drafted three; 300 li, four; and 100 li or more, five.

sentences.zh: 有司訓練，遇警調發，給以行糧，而禁役佔放買之弊。

translations.literal: Local officials trained them; when alarms arose they were mobilized and given campaign grain, while abuses of impressment, detention, and bought substitutes were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates drilled them and mobilized them in emergencies with marching rations, while impressment, detention, and purchased substitutes were banned.

sentences.zh: 富民不願，則上直於官，官自為募。

translations.literal: If wealthy households were unwilling, then they paid silver straight to the official, and officials recruited on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy men who refused could pay silver to the magistrate instead, and officials would recruit in their stead.

sentences.zh: 或稱機兵，在巡檢司者稱弓兵。

translations.literal: Some were called rapid-response troops; those at inspection stations were called bow troops.
translations.idiomatic: Some were termed rapid-response troops; those at inspection stations, bowmen.

sentences.zh: 後以越境防冬非計，大同巡撫劉宇請免其班操，徵銀糧輸大同，而以威遠屯丁、舍餘補役。

translations.literal: Later because cross-border winter defense was deemed unwise, Datong grand coordinator Liu Yu requested exempting them from rotating duties, levying silver grain for Datong, while Weiyuan garrison laborers and surplus sons filled the roles.
translations.idiomatic: Winter duty across borders was later judged imprudent; Datong governor Liu Yu asked to end their rotating service, collect silver and grain for Datong, and fill gaps with Weiyuan colonists and surplus household sons.

sentences.zh: 給事中熊偉亦請編應募民於附近衛所。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Xiong Wei also requested registering recruited civilians in nearby guard units.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Xiong Wei also asked to enroll recruits in nearby guards.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were followed.
translations.idiomatic: Both recommendations were adopted.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以西北諸邊所募士兵，多不足五千，遣使□銀二十萬及太僕寺馬價銀四萬往募。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because recruited soldiers on the northwest frontiers mostly fell short of five thousand, envoys were dispatched carrying two hundred thousand taels of silver and forty thousand taels of horse-price silver from the Court of the Imperial Stud to recruit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, with frontier recruits often numbering fewer than 5,000 per sector, envoys were sent bearing 200,000 taels of silver and 40,000 taels of stud-fund silver to recruit more.

sentences.zh: 指揮千百戶以募兵多寡為差，得遷級，失官者得復職，即令統所募兵。

translations.literal: Company and battalion commanders, according to the difference in how many troops they recruited, could gain promotion in rank; those who had lost office could recover post, and were at once ordered to command the troops they recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Company and battalion commanders were promoted according to how many men they recruited; disgraced officers could regain rank and immediately command their recruits.

sentences.zh: 既而兵部議覆侍郎李孟暘請實軍伍疏，謂：「天下衛所官軍原額二百七十餘萬，歲久逃故，嘗選民壯三十餘萬，又核衛所舍人、餘丁八十八萬，西北諸邊召募士兵無慮數萬。

translations.literal: Soon after the Ministry of War deliberated in reply to Vice Minister Li Mengyang's memorial requesting filling army rolls, stating: "Under heaven guard official troops' original quota was more than 2.7 million; over the years desertion and death occurred; once thirty-odd ten thousand civilian strongmen were selected; again guard household dependents and surplus sons were tallied at 880,000; northwest frontiers recruited garrison soldiers numbering no less than tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The War Ministry soon replied to Vice Minister Li Mengyang's petition to fill the rolls: "Guard troops had originally numbered more than 2.7 million nationwide, but desertion and mortality had eroded them over time. Some 300,000 militiamen had been selected, another 880,000 dependents and surplus sons tallied, and northwest recruitment had raised tens of thousands of garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 請如孟暘奏，察有司不操練民壯、私役雜差者，如役佔軍人罪。」

translations.literal: Request following Mengyang's memorial: investigate officials who did not drill civilian strongmen and privately used them for miscellaneous corvée, punishing as with the crime of impressing and detaining military personnel."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that officials who failed to drill militia or diverted them to private labor be punished like those who impressed garrison troops."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Reply: approved.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 正德中，流賊擾山東，巡撫張鳳選民兵，令自買馬團操，民不勝其擾。

translations.literal: In the Zhengde reign, roaming bandits harassed Shandong; Grand Coordinator Zhang Feng selected militia and ordered them to buy their own horses for group drill; the people could not bear the harassment.
translations.idiomatic: Mid Zhengde, bandits ravaged Shandong; Governor Zhang Feng drafted militia and required them to buy horses for drill, and commoners were driven past endurance.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎楊潭以為言。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Yang Tan spoke on it.
translations.idiomatic: War Vice Minister Yang Tan lodged a protest.

sentences.zh: 都御史寧杲所募多無賴子，為御史張璇所劾。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Ning Gao's recruits were mostly ruffians and were impeached by Censor Zhang Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Censor-in-Chief Ning Gao's recruits were ruffians, and censor Zhang Xuan impeached him for it.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十二年增州縣民壯額，大者千人，次六七百，小者五百。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiajing prefecture and county civilian strongman quotas were increased: large ones a thousand men, medium six or seven hundred, small five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing year 22 raised county militia quotas to 1,000 for large counties, 600-700 for medium, and 500 for small.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，京師新被寇，議募民兵，以二萬為率。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the capital having newly been raided, recruiting militia was discussed, with twenty thousand as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29, after fresh raids on the capital, officials debated recruiting 20,000 militiamen as a target.

sentences.zh: 歲四月終，赴近京防禦。

translations.literal: At the end of the fourth month each year they went to defend near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Each year by late fourth month they reported to capital-area defense.

sentences.zh: 後五年，兵部尚書楊博請汰老弱，存精銳，在外者發各道為民兵，在京者隸之巡捕參將，逃者不補。

translations.literal: Five years later Minister of War Yang Bo requested eliminating old and weak, retaining elite, sending those outside out to various circuits as militia, those in the capital subordinating them to patrol vice generals; deserters were not replaced.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later War Minister Yang Bo asked to purge the old and weak and keep the fit: provincials to circuit militia, capital men to patrol vice-generals, with no replacement for deserters.

sentences.zh: 帝以影占數多，耗糧無用，遣官核宜罷宜還者以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor considered shadow enrollees numerous, grain wasted uselessly, and sent officials to verify who should be dismissed and who returned and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor judged too many men existed only on paper, wasting grain to no purpose, and sent officers to audit who should be cut or restored.

sentences.zh: 隆慶中，張居正、陳以勤復請籍畿甸民兵，謂： 「直隸八府人多健悍，總按戶籍，除單丁老弱者，父子三人籍一子，兄弟三人籍一弟，州與大縣可得千六百人，小縣可得千人。

translations.literal: In the Longqing reign Zhang Juzheng and Chen Yiqin again requested registering capital-region militia, stating: "The eight Zhili prefectures' people are mostly sturdy and fierce; tallying by household registers, excluding sole sons, the old, and the weak, where father and three sons register one son, where three brothers register one younger brother, large prefectures and counties can obtain sixteen hundred men, small counties a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing Zhang Juzheng and Chen Yiqin again petitioned to register capital militia: "Zhili's eight prefectures abound in hardy men. By household registers, excluding only sons, the elderly, and the infirm, registering one son per household of three males or one younger brother per trio of brothers, a major prefecture or county could field 1,600 men and a small county 1,000.

sentences.zh: 中分之為正兵、奇兵，登名尺籍，隸撫臣操練，歲無過三月，月無過三次，練畢即令歸農，復其身。

translations.literal: Halve them into regular and skirmisher troops, inscribe names on measuring-scroll registers, subordinate to grand coordinators for drill, no more than three months per year, no more than three times per month; when drill ended they were ordered to return to farming and their corvée exemptions restored.
translations.idiomatic: They would be split into regular and skirmish companies, enrolled on regimental rolls, trained by governors no more than three months a year and three sessions a month, then sent home to farm with corvée exemption restored.

sentences.zh: 歲操外，不得別遣。」

translations.literal: Outside the yearly drill they might not be separately dispatched."
translations.idiomatic: Apart from annual drill they could not be deployed elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 命所司議行。

translations.literal: An order commanded the responsible offices to deliberate implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were ordered to study implementation.

sentences.zh: 然自嘉靖後，山東、河南民兵戍薊門者，率徵銀以充召募。

translations.literal: Yet from after Jiajing, Shandong and Henan militia garrisoning Jimen mostly had silver levied to fill recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet after Jiajing Shandong and Henan militia sent to Jimen were generally commuted to silver levies for recruitment.

sentences.zh: 至萬曆初，山東徵銀至五萬六千兩，貧民大困。

translations.literal: By the beginning of Wanli, Shandong's silver levies reached fifty-six thousand taels; poor people were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: By early Wanli Shandong's levy had reached 56,000 taels, impoverishing commoners.

sentences.zh: 治河之役，給事中張貞觀請益募士兵，捍淮、揚、徐、邳。

translations.literal: For the Yellow River control project, Supervising Secretary Zhang Zhenguan requested increasing recruitment of garrison soldiers to defend Huai, Yang, Xu, and Pei.
translations.idiomatic: During river-work supervising secretary Zhang Zhenguan asked to recruit more garrison troops for Huai, Yang, Xu, and Pei.

sentences.zh: 畿南盜起，給事中耿隨龍請復民壯舊制，專捕賊盜。

translations.literal: Bandits arose south of the capital region; Supervising Secretary Geng Suilong requested restoring the old civilian strongman system, exclusively capturing robbers and bandits.
translations.idiomatic: With banditry flaring south of the capital, supervising secretary Geng Suilong urged restoring the old militia system devoted solely to bandit suppression.

sentences.zh: 播州之亂，工部侍郎趙可懷請練土著，兵部因言：「天下之無兵者，不獨蜀也。

translations.literal: In the Bozhou rebellion, Vice Minister of Works Zhao Kehuai requested drilling native inhabitants; the Ministry of War accordingly said: "Places under heaven without troops are not only Shu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Bozhou revolt Works Vice Minister Zhao Kehuai petitioned to drill local levies; the War Ministry noted: "Sichuan is not the only province short of troops.

sentences.zh: 各省官軍、民壯，皆宜罷老稚，易以健卒。

translations.literal: Each province's official troops and civilian strongmen should all dismiss old and young, replacing them with sturdy soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Official and militia forces in every province should replace old and young with fit men.

sentences.zh: 軍操屬印官、操官，民操屬正官、捕官，郡守、監司不得牽制。

translations.literal: Army drill belonged to seal-bearing officers and drill officers; civilian drill belonged to chief magistrates and constables; prefects and surveillance commissioners might not interfere.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison drill should rest with seal officers and drill officers, militia drill with magistrates and constables, without interference from prefects or surveillance commissioners.

sentences.zh: 立營分伍，以憑調發。」

translations.literal: Establish camps and divide companies for reliance in mobilization."
translations.idiomatic: Establish camps and companies for orderly mobilization."

sentences.zh: 先後皆議行。

translations.literal: Each in turn was deliberated for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Each proposal was adopted in turn.

sentences.zh: 末年，募兵措餉益急。

translations.literal: In the dynasty's last years, recruiting troops and raising funds grew ever more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's final years recruitment and fund-raising grew desperate.

sentences.zh: 南京職方郎中鄒維璉陳調募之害。

translations.literal: Nanjing Bureau of Military Appointments director Zou Weilian set forth the harms of mobilization and recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing Bureau director Zou Weilian detailed the harm of mobilization and recruitment.

sentences.zh: 山西參政徐九翰尤極言民兵不可調。

translations.literal: Shanxi Assistant Commissioner Xu Jiuhan especially spoke at length that militia could not be mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi assistant commissioner Xu Jiuhan especially argued that militia should not be mobilized.

sentences.zh: 崇禎時，中原盜急，兵部尚書楊嗣昌議令責州縣訓練土著為兵。

translations.literal: In the Chongzhen reign, central plains banditry was urgent; Minister of War Yang Sichang deliberated ordering prefectures and counties to train native inhabitants as troops.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chongzhen, with banditry raging in the central plains, War Minister Yang Sichang proposed ordering counties to drill local levies as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎張慎言言其不便者數事，而御史米壽圖又言其害有十，謂不若簡練民兵，增民壯快手，備御地方為便。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Zhang Shenyan spoke of several inconveniences; Censor Mi Shoutu again said its harms had ten points, stating it was better to select and drill militia, increase civilian strongman swift runners, and prepare defense of local places as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Works Vice Minister Zhang Shenyan cited several problems; censor Mi Shoutu listed ten harms and argued that drilling militia and adding swift militia runners for local defense would be better.

sentences.zh: 後嗣昌死，練兵亦不行。

translations.literal: Later Sichang died, and drilling troops likewise was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: After Sichang's death the training scheme never took effect.

sentences.zh: 鄉兵者，隨其風土所長應募，調佐軍旅緩急。

translations.literal: Village troops were men recruited according to what local custom excelled at, mobilized to assist the army in urgency or ease.
translations.idiomatic: Local militia were recruited for whatever skills their region offered and called up to reinforce the regular army as needed.

sentences.zh: 其隸軍籍者曰浙兵，義烏為最，處次之，台、寧又次之，善狼筅，間以叉槊。

translations.literal: Those enrolled in military registers were called Zhe troops; Yiwu were foremost, Chu next, Tai and Ning again next; skilled with wolf-brushes, sometimes mixed with fork spears.
translations.idiomatic: Those on the rolls were Zhejiang troops: Yiwu men ranked first, Chu second, Taizhou and Ningbo third, expert with wolf-brush poles and sometimes forked spears.

sentences.zh: 戚繼光制鴛鴦陣以破倭，及守薊門，最有名。

translations.literal: Qi Jiguang devised the Mandarin-duck formation to defeat pirates; when guarding Jimen he was most renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Jiguang's mandarin-duck formation broke the pirates, and his fame peaked when he held Jimen.

sentences.zh: 曰川兵、曰遼兵，崇禎時，多調之剿流賊。

translations.literal: Called Sichuan troops, called Liaodong troops; in Chongzhen they were often mobilized to suppress roaming bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Liaodong troops were often dispatched under Chongzhen against bandit armies.

sentences.zh: 其不隸軍籍者，所在多有。

translations.literal: Those not enrolled in military registers existed everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Unregistered local forces existed everywhere.

sentences.zh: 河南嵩縣曰毛葫蘆，習短兵，長於走山。

translations.literal: Song County in Henan had Hairy Gourds, practiced short weapons, excelled at mountain running.
translations.idiomatic: Song County in Henan fielded 'Hairy Gourd' men skilled with short arms and mountain marches.

sentences.zh: 而嵩及盧氏、靈寶、永寧並多礦兵，曰角腦，又曰打手。

translations.literal: Song together with Lushi, Lingbao, and Yongning all had many mine troops, called Horn-Brains, also called Strike Hands.
translations.idiomatic: Song, Lushi, Lingbao, and Yongning also had mine-guard levies called Horn-Brains or Strike Hands.

sentences.zh: 山東有長竿手。

translations.literal: Shandong had long-pole hands.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had long-pole fighters.

sentences.zh: 徐州有箭手。

translations.literal: Xuzhou had archers.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou fielded archers.

sentences.zh: 井陘有螞螂手，善運石，遠可及百步。

translations.literal: Jingxing had mantis hands, skilled at hurling stones, reaching a hundred paces distant.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxing had 'mantis' stone-slingers who could strike a hundred paces.

sentences.zh: 閩漳、泉習鏢牌，水戰為最。

translations.literal: Fujian Zhang and Quan practiced dart-shields; in naval warfare they were foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzhou and Quanzhou men trained with shield and dart, unrivaled in naval combat.

sentences.zh: 泉州永春人善技擊。

translations.literal: Yongchun men of Quanzhou excelled at martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchun men near Quanzhou were famed for martial arts.

sentences.zh: 正統間，郭榮六者，破沙尤賊有功。

translations.literal: In the Zhengtong period Guo Rong and six others had merit breaking the Shayo bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengtong era Guo Rong and six companions distinguished themselves against the Shayo rebels.

sentences.zh: 商灶鹽丁以私販為業，多勁果。

translations.literal: Salt-boilers of mercantile salterns took private trafficking as livelihood; many were sturdy and resolute.
translations.idiomatic: Saltern laborers who lived by smuggling were often rugged and resolute.

sentences.zh: 成化初，河東鹽徒千百輩，自備火砲、強弩、車仗，雜官軍逐寇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua, Hedong salt laborers in the hundreds, self-providing cannon, strong crossbows, and wagons, mixed with official troops to pursue raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Early Chenghua saw hundreds of Hedong salt workers armed with cannon, crossbows, and wagons join regular troops against raiders.

sentences.zh: 而松江曹涇鹽徒，嘉靖中逐倭至島上，焚其舟。

translations.literal: Songjiang Caojing salt laborers in Jiajing pursued pirates to the islands and burned their boats.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang Caojing salt smugglers in the Jiajing era pursued pirates offshore and burned their boats.

sentences.zh: 後倭見民家有鹺囊，輒搖手相戒。

translations.literal: Later when pirates saw civilian households with brine bags they would shake hands warning each other.
translations.idiomatic: Pirates later took warning at the sight of brine bags in a cottage.

sentences.zh: 粵東雜蠻蜑，習長牌、斫刀，而新會、東莞之產強半。

translations.literal: Guangdong east mixed southern barbarians and boat people practiced long shields and chopper blades; Xinhui and Dongguan productions made up more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Guangdong's Tanka and other boat people trained with long shields and cleavers, especially from Xinhui and Dongguan.

sentences.zh: 延綏、固原多邊外土著，善騎射，英宗命簡練以備秋防。

translations.literal: Yan-sui and Guyuan had many frontier native inhabitants skilled at mounted archery; Emperor Ying ordered selection and drill to prepare autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yan-sui and Guyuan had many frontier natives skilled in mounted archery; the Yingzong Emperor ordered them drilled for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 大滕峽之役，韓雍用之，以摧瑤、僮之用牌刀者。

translations.literal: In the Great Teng Gorge campaign Han Yong used them to crush Yao and Zhuang who wielded shield-blades.
translations.idiomatic: At the Great Teng Gorge Han Yong deployed them against Yao and Zhuang shield-blade fighters.

sentences.zh: 莊浪魯家軍，舊隸隨駕中，洪熙初，令土指揮領之。

translations.literal: Zhuanglang Lu family army originally belonged among the emperor's following guard; at the beginning of Hongxi, native commanders were ordered to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuanglang's Lu family troops had once served in the imperial escort; in early Hongxi native commanders were appointed to lead them.

sentences.zh: 萬曆間，部臣稱其驍健，為敵所畏，宜鼓舞以儲邊用。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign ministry officials said they were fierce and healthy, feared by enemies, and should be encouraged to store border use.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli officials praised them as fierce and feared by enemies, and urged support to keep them ready for frontier service.

sentences.zh: 西寧馬戶八百，嘗自備騎械赴敵，後以款貢裁之。

translations.literal: Xining's eight hundred horse households once self-provided mounted gear to meet enemies; later because of peace treaties and tribute they were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Xining's 800 horse households once armed themselves for battle until peace treaties and tribute payments led to their reduction.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十九年，經略鄭雒請復其故。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Wanli Grand Coordinator Zheng Luo requested restoring their former state.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 19 frontier commissioner Zheng Luo asked to restore the old arrangement.

sentences.zh: 又僧兵，有少林、伏牛、五臺。

translations.literal: Again monk troops: there were Shaolin, Funiu, and Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: Monk levies included Shaolin, Funiu, and Wutai.

sentences.zh: 倭亂，少林僧應募者四十餘人，戰亦多勝。

translations.literal: In the pirate turmoil more than forty Shaolin monks who answered recruitment fought and often won.
translations.idiomatic: During the pirate wars more than forty Shaolin monks enlisted and won many fights.

sentences.zh: 西南邊服有各土司兵。

translations.literal: Southwest border regions had each native office's troops.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest marches fielded native chieftain troops.

sentences.zh: 湖南永順、保靖二宣慰所部，廣西東蘭、那地、南丹、歸順諸狼兵，四川酉陽、石砫秦氏、冉氏諸司，宣力最多。

translations.literal: Yongshun and Baojing two pacification commissions' subordinates in Hunan, Guangxi's Donglan, Nadi, Nandan, Guishun various wolf troops, Sichuan's Youyang, Shizhu Qin and Ran clans' various offices — they declared strength most numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Yongshun and Baojing commissions, Guangxi wolf troops of Donglan, Nadi, Nandan, and Guishun, and Sichuan's Youyang and Shizhu Qin and Ran chieftains contributed the greatest forces.

sentences.zh: 末年，邊事急，有司專以調三省土司為長策，其利害亦恆相半云。

translations.literal: In the last years border affairs were urgent; local officials exclusively took mobilizing the three provinces' native chiefs as the long-term plan — its benefit and harm also constantly halved each other, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: In the final years frontier crisis led officials to treat mobilizing chieftains from three provinces as the master strategy — a policy whose gains and losses, it was said, always weighed evenly.
